This markdown performs the main analysis for pipeline benchmarking. 
It summarizes combines the pipeline output into TSE or objects (or refers to scripts that do so) and
calculates the benchmarking metrics (precision, recall, Jaccard, correlation; or refers scripts that do so)

```{r set_paths, echo=TRUE}
get_list_names <- function(x) {
  is_list <- function(z) is.list(z) && !is.data.frame(z)

  res <- list()
  current <- list(x)
  level <- 1

  while (length(current) > 0) {
    lvl_names <- character(0)
    next_level <- list()

    for (el in current) {
      n <- names(el)
      if (is.null(n)) n <- rep("", length(el))
      for (i in seq_along(el)) {
        if (n[i] != "") lvl_names <- c(lvl_names, n[i])
        if (is_list(el[[i]])) next_level <- c(next_level, list(el[[i]]))
      }
    }

    if (length(lvl_names) > 0) res[[paste0("level_", level)]] <- unique(lvl_names)
    current <- next_level
    level <- level + 1
  }
  res
}
```

# Combine output
## All tables into a list
```{r alloutput, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

alloutput <- list()
meta <- read_tsv(file = datasets$meta[datasets$datasets %in% "parkinson"], col_names = TRUE)
park_excl <- meta %>% filter(sequencing_pool %in% "dataset_2_6") %>% pull(run_accession)

for (d in datasets$datasets) {

    # Filenames of raw sequences
    alloutput[[d]][["raw"]] <- list.files(path = datasets$raw[datasets$datasets == d], 
                  pattern = "\\.fastq\\.gz$", 
                  full.names = TRUE)
    alloutput[[d]][["reads_in"]] <- data.frame(read_tsv(datasets$reads_in[datasets$datasets == d])) 
    colnames(alloutput[[d]][["reads_in"]])[1] <- "sample_names"

    exp_tax <- datasets$tax[datasets$datasets == d]
    
    if (file.exists(exp_tax)) alloutput[[d]][["exp_tax"]] <-  data.frame(read_tsv(exp_tax))
    
    for (p in pipelines) {
        print(paste0("Loading dataset: ", d, " | Pipeline: ", p))
         
        suffix <- ifelse(grepl("_otu", p), "_otu", "")
        p2 <- gsub("_otu", "", p)

        # Feature table
        feat <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/feature-table", suffix, "_post.tsv")
        if (file.exists(feat)) {
          df <- read_tsv(feat)
          if (colnames(df)[1] != "ID") colnames(df)[1] <- "ID"

          if (nrow(df) == 0) {
            next   
          } else { 

            if (sum(colnames(df) %in% park_excl) > 0) df <- df %>% select(-all_of(park_excl))
            alloutput[[d]][[p]][["feat"]] <- df %>% 
              column_to_rownames("ID")               
          }
       }
                
        # Taxonomy table
        tax <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/taxonomy", suffix, "_post.tsv")
        if (file.exists(tax)) alloutput[[d]][[p]][["tax"]] <-  data.frame(read_tsv(tax)) %>% column_to_rownames("ID") 

        if (p %in% "Tourmaline") {
          cnames <- c("kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus")
          alloutput[[d]][[p]][["tax"]]$kingdom <- NULL
          colnames(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["tax"]]) <- cnames
        }

        # DNA sequences
        dna <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/dna-sequences", suffix, "_post.fasta")
        if (file.exists(dna)) alloutput[[d]][[p]][["dna"]] <-  readDNAStringSet(dna, format = "fasta", use.names = TRUE)

        # Taxonomy (idtaxa & q2 naive bayes | silva & GreenGenes) 
        if (!p %in% "NGTax2") {
          idtaxa <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/idtaxa", suffix, "_V4.tsv")
          idtaxa_gg <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/idtaxa", suffix, "_gg_V4.tsv")

          q2 <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/q2_nb_silva", suffix, ".tsv")
          q2_gg <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/q2_nb_gg", suffix, ".tsv")

        } else {
          idtaxa <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/idtaxa", "_concat", suffix, "_V4.tsv")
          idtaxa_gg <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/idtaxa", "_concat", suffix, "_gg_V4.tsv")

          q2 <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/q2_nb_silva_concat", suffix, ".tsv")
          q2_gg <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/q2_nb_gg_concat", suffix, ".tsv")
        }

        if (file.exists(idtaxa)) {
          alloutput[[d]][[p]][["idtaxa"]] <-  data.frame(read_tsv(idtaxa)) %>% column_to_rownames("ID")
          colnames(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["idtaxa"]])[1] <- "kingdom"
        }  

        if (file.exists(idtaxa_gg)) {
          alloutput[[d]][[p]][["idtaxa_gg"]] <-  data.frame(read_tsv(idtaxa_gg)) %>% column_to_rownames("ID")
          colnames(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["idtaxa_gg"]])[1] <- "kingdom"
        }  

        if (file.exists(q2)) {
          alloutput[[d]][[p]][["q2"]] <- data.frame(read_tsv(q2)) %>% column_to_rownames("ID")
        }

        if (file.exists(q2_gg)) {
          alloutput[[d]][[p]][["q2_gg"]] <-  data.frame(read_tsv(q2_gg)) %>% column_to_rownames("ID")
        }

        # Also add the forward only for comparison (only NGTax)
        if (p %in% "NGTax2") {
          idtaxa <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/idtaxa", suffix, "_V4.tsv")

          if (file.exists(idtaxa)) {
          alloutput[[d]][[p]][["idtaxa_R1"]] <-  data.frame(read_tsv(idtaxa)) %>% column_to_rownames("ID")
          colnames(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["idtaxa_R1"]])[1] <- "kingdom"
          }  

          q2 <- paste0(output_base_path, p2, "/output/", d, "/q2_nb_silva", suffix, ".tsv")
          if (file.exists(q2)) alloutput[[d]][[p]][["q2_R1"]] <-  data.frame(read_tsv(q2)) %>% column_to_rownames("ID")
       }

        # Recall and precision data (for mock and simulations)
        if (!d %in% c("gemsim", "mindset")) {
            recall <- paste0(recall_base_path, p2, "_", d, suffix, ".tsv")
            if (file.exists(recall)) alloutput[[d]][[p]][["recall"]] <- data.frame(read_tsv(recall)) %>% column_to_rownames("sequence.ID")

            precision <- paste0(precision_base_path, p2, "_", d, suffix, ".tsv")
            if (file.exists(precision)) alloutput[[d]][[p]][["precision"]] <- data.frame(read_tsv(precision))
        }
    }

  if (d %in% mocks) alloutput[[d]][["Natrix_filt"]] <- alloutput[[d]][["Natrix"]]
}
```

## Create TSEs
### ASV-level & Picrust-level TSEs
```{r tse_asv, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

# See scripts/helper/asv_tse.sh 
#  This script combines the feature tables into one using a VSEARCH dereplication (.uc) file
# For the large datasets (mindset/gemsim this took a long time, so I put it in a separate slurm script)

# Filenames: tse_[classifier]_[dataset]_asv_allpipelines.rds

# Picrust into tse
# scripts/helper/picrust_tse.R 

# Create expected tse for picrust (KO and cyc) - Only for simulations 
path_KO <- "/projects/0/gs/danique/pipelines/simulations/picrust/KO_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_unstrat.tsv.gz"
path_cyc <- "/projects/0/gs/danique/pipelines/simulations/picrust/pathways_out/path_abun_unstrat.tsv.gz"

for (lev in c("KO", "cyc")) {
  print(lev)
  feat <- read_tsv(get(paste0("path_", lev))) %>% 
    column_to_rownames(colnames(.)[1])

  meta <- data.frame(pipeline = "Expected", sample = colnames(feat)) %>%
    mutate(ID = paste0(pipeline, "_", sample))

  rownames(meta) <- meta$ID
  colnames(feat) <- meta$ID

  tax <- data.frame(func=rownames(feat))
  rownames(tax) <- rownames(feat)   

  tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
            assays =  SimpleList(counts = as.matrix(feat)),
            colData = DataFrame(meta),
            rowData = DataFrame(tax)) # KO-level ASV

  saveRDS(tse, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", lev, "_exp_simulation.rds"))

  for (d in sims) {
    print(d)
    tse_obs <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", lev, "_", d, "picrust_allpipelines.rds"))
    feat_obs <- data.frame(assay(tse_obs)) %>% rownames_to_column(var = "function")
    meta_obs <- data.frame(colData(tse_obs))

    feat_tot <- feat_obs %>%
      dplyr::left_join(., feat %>% rownames_to_column(var = "function"), by = "function") %>%
      column_to_rownames(var = "function")
    
    feat_tot[is.na(feat_tot)] <- 0

    meta_tot <- meta_obs %>% 
      bind_rows(meta)
    # Combine tables 

    tax_tot <- data.frame(func = rownames(feat_tot))
    
    tse_tot <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
            assays =  SimpleList(counts = as.matrix(feat_tot)),
            colData = DataFrame(meta_tot),
            rowData = DataFrame(tax_tot))

    saveRDS(tse_tot, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", lev, "_", d, "_picrust_exp_allpipelines.rds"))  
  }
}

```

### Genus-level TSEs
Including TSE for expected communities
```{r tse_genus, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

#  Combine all tables into one (genus level for now)
alloutput <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "all_tables_combined.rds"))
algorithms_df <- read_tsv(algorithms) %>% select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  for (c in "tax") { # c(classifiers, "q2_gg", "idtaxa_gg")

    tse_all <- list() # save all tse at asv level 
    feat_gen <- data.frame(genus = character())
    tax_gen <- data.frame(kingdom = character(),
                          phylum = character(),
                          class = character(),
                          order = character(),
                          family = character(),
                          genus = character(),
                          species = character())
    
    # Create meta_tot 
    meta_tot <- data.frame(
      sample = character(),
      pipeline = character(),
      ID = character(),
      primer=character(),
      qc=character(),
      denoising=character(),
      chimera=character(),
      merging=character(),
      post=character(),
      tax=character(),
      db=character())

    for (p in pipelines) { 

      print(paste0("Dataset: ", d, " | Classifier: ", c, " | Pipeline: ", p))
    
      if (is.null(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["feat"]])) next

      feat <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][["feat"]] %>%
        select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>% as.matrix()

      if (is.null(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["tax"]])) next
      tax <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][[c]]
            
      rn <- rownames(tax)
      tax <- sapply(colnames(tax), function(x) { gsub("^[a-z]__", "", tax[[x]]) }) # needed for idtaxa
      rownames(tax) <- rn

      meta <- data.frame(sample = colnames(feat),
                        pipeline = rep(p, ncol(feat))) 

      colnames(feat) <- paste0(p, "_", colnames(feat))
      meta$ID <- colnames(feat)

      meta <- meta %>%
        dplyr::left_join(., algorithms_df, by = "pipeline")
      rownames(meta) <- colnames(feat)

      if (!is.null(tax)) {

        if (length(setdiff(rownames(feat), rownames(tax))) > 0) {
          warning(paste("Features in feat but not in tax for pipeline", p, "in dataset", d))
          diff <- setdiff(rownames(feat), rownames(tax))
          message(paste("Adding missing features ( n =", length(diff), ") to tax table with values NA for pipeline", p))
          diff_df <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = length(diff), ncol = ncol(tax)))
          colnames(diff_df) <- colnames(tax)
          rownames(diff_df) <- diff
          tax <- tax %>%
            rbind(diff_df)
        }

        if (length(setdiff(rownames(tax), rownames(feat))) > 0) {
          stop(paste("Features in tax but not in feat for pipeline", p, "in dataset", d))
        }

        feat <- feat[match(rownames(tax), rownames(feat), nomatch = 0), ] %>% as.matrix()

        print(identical(rownames(tax), rownames(feat)))

        tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
          assays =  SimpleList(counts = feat),
          colData = DataFrame(meta),
          rowData = DataFrame(tax)) # asv-level tse

        if (all(is.na(rowData(tse)$genus))) {
          message(paste0("No genus labels for pipeline ", p, ". Skipping..."))
          next # no genus-level classification available. Skip
        }

        tse_genus <- agglomerateByRank(tse, rank = "genus") # genus-level tse
        rowData(tse_genus)$genus <- rownames(tse_genus)

        tse_genus <- tse_genus[!is.na(rowData(tse_genus)$genus),]
        tse_genus <- tse_genus[!rowData(tse_genus)$genus %in% c("NA", "uncultured", "Incertae_Sedis", "?"),]
        tse_genus <- tse_genus[!grepl("unclassified", rowData(tse_genus)$genus),]

        new_rows <- sapply(rowData(tse), function(r) {
          r[grepl("unclassified|NA|Incertae_Sedis|uncultured|No hit|\\?", r)] <- NA
          return(r)
        }) %>% as.data.frame()
        rownames(new_rows) <- rownames(tse)

        rowData(tse) <- DataFrame(new_rows)
        
        tse_all[[p]] <- tse # add to main list

        feat_gen_tmp <- assay(tse_genus, "counts") %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "genus")
        tax_gen_tmp <- rowData(tse_genus) %>% as.data.frame()

        feat_gen <- feat_gen %>%
          dplyr::full_join(., feat_gen_tmp, by = "genus")

        # Add all genera not in the tax table yet to the tax table
        if (sum(!tax_gen_tmp$genus %in% tax_gen$genus) > 0) {
          tax_gen <- tax_gen %>%
            add_row(tax_gen_tmp[!tax_gen_tmp$genus %in% tax_gen$genus,])
        }

        meta_tot <- meta_tot %>% add_row(meta)  
  
      }
    }
 
    # Combine into one large tse 
    feat_gen <- feat_gen %>%
      column_to_rownames("genus")
    feat_gen[is.na(feat_gen)] <- 0
    feat_gen <- as.matrix(feat_gen)

    rownames(meta_tot) <- meta_tot$ID
    print(identical(colnames(feat_gen), rownames(meta_tot)))

    if (length(setdiff(rownames(feat_gen), tax_gen$genus))) stop("N features in feat_gen that are not in tax_gen$genus")
    if (length(setdiff(tax_gen$genus, rownames(feat_gen)))) stop("N features in feat_gen that are not in tax_gen$genus")

    tax_gen <- tax_gen[match(rownames(feat_gen), tax_gen$genus), ]
    rownames(tax_gen) <- tax_gen$genus
    print(identical(rownames(tax_gen), rownames(feat_gen)))

    tse_full <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
      assays =  SimpleList(counts = feat_gen),
      colData = DataFrame(meta_tot),
      rowData = DataFrame(tax_gen)) 

    assays(tse_full)
  
    if (c %in% "tax") c <- "deftax"

    saveRDS(tse_full, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_genus_allpipelines.rds"))
    saveRDS(tse_all, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))

  }
}


################################################################
# Add expected composition
################################################################
for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% reals]) {
  for (c in classifiers) { 
    print(paste(d, "|", c))

    tse_full <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_genus_allpipelines.rds"))
    tse_full <- transformAssay(tse_full, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = 0)
    feat_gen <- assay(tse_full, "relabundance") %>% as.data.frame()
    tax_gen <- rowData(tse_full) %>% as.data.frame()
    meta_tot <- colData(tse_full) %>% as.data.frame()

    # Expected composition
    feat_exp <- read_tsv(datasets$comp[datasets$datasets %in% d], col_names=TRUE)
    
    if (grepl("mock", d)) {
      rn <- feat_exp$Taxonomy %>% str_split(";") %>% sapply(function(x) x[length(x)])
      feat_exp <- feat_exp %>% select(-Taxonomy) 
    } else if (grepl("sim", d)) {
      rn <- feat_exp$featureID
      feat_exp <- feat_exp %>% select(-featureID)
    } 

    feat_exp <- as.matrix(feat_exp)
    rownames(feat_exp) <- rn

    # Get expected taxonomy
    tax_exp <- read_tsv(datasets$tax[datasets$datasets %in% d], col_names=ifelse(grepl("mock", d),FALSE, TRUE))
    
    if (grepl("mock5", d)) { 
      tax_exp <- tax_exp %>% separate(X1, into = c("phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species"), sep = ";", fill = "right")
      tax_exp$genus <- tax_exp$X2 # updated genus label (following silva 138)
      tax_exp <- tax_exp %>% select(-X3, -X2) 
      tax_exp$id <- tax_exp$species
    } else if (grepl("mock12", d)) {
      tax_exp <- tax_exp %>%
        select(id=X1, genus=X2, -X3) %>%
        mutate(kingdom=NA, phylum=NA, class=NA, order=NA, family=NA, genus=genus, species=NA) %>%
        select(id, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species)
    } else if (grepl("sim", d)) {

      tax_exp <- tax_exp %>% separate(Taxon, into = c("kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species"), sep = "; ", fill = "right")
      tax_exp <- sapply(tax_exp, function(x) gsub("^[dpcofgs]__", "", x)) %>% data.frame()

      tax_exp$id <- tax_exp$SILVA_ID
      tax_exp$SILVA_ID <- NULL
    }
    
    # reorder taxonomy to match features
    # colnames(tax_exp) <- c("id", "genus")
    tax_exp <- tax_exp[match(rownames(feat_exp), tax_exp$id), ]
    rownames(tax_exp) <- NULL
    tax_exp <- tax_exp %>% column_to_rownames(., "id")
    identical(rownames(tax_exp), rownames(feat_exp))

    # Create metadata
    if (d == "mock5") {
      meta <- data.frame(sample = c("Even1", "Even2", "Staggered1", "Staggered2"),
                        pipeline = rep("Expected", ncol(feat_exp)))
    } else if (d == "mock12") {
      meta <- data.frame(sample = c("mock12"),
                        pipeline = rep("Expected", ncol(feat_exp)))
    } else if (grep("sim", d)) {
      meta <- data.frame(sample = colnames(feat_exp),
                        pipeline = rep("Expected", ncol(feat_exp)))
    }

    colnames(feat_exp) <- paste0("Expected", "_", meta$sample)
    meta$ID <- colnames(feat_exp)
    rownames(meta) <- colnames(feat_exp)
    
    if (d %in% "mock12") {
      rn <- str_split(rownames(tax_exp), " ") %>% sapply(function(x) paste0(x[1], "_", x[2]))
      rownames(tax_exp) <- paste0(seq(1:length(rn)), "_", rn)
      rownames(feat_exp) <- rownames(tax_exp)
    }

    # Create tse
    tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
      assays =  SimpleList(start = feat_exp),
      colData = DataFrame(meta),
      rowData = DataFrame(tax_exp))

    tse <- transformAssay(tse, assay.type = "start", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = 0) 
    assay(tse, "start") <- NULL

    saveRDS(tse, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds"))

    tse_genus <- agglomerateByRank(tse, rank = "genus")
    saveRDS(tse_genus, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_genus_", d, ".rds"))

    feat_gen_tmp <- assay(tse_genus, "relabundance") %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "genus")
    tax_gen_tmp <- rowData(tse_genus) %>% as.data.frame()

    feat_gen <- feat_gen %>%
      rownames_to_column("genus") %>%
      dplyr::full_join(., feat_gen_tmp, by = "genus") %>%
      column_to_rownames("genus")
      
    feat_gen[is.na(feat_gen)] <- 0
    feat_gen <- as.matrix(feat_gen)

    if (sum(!tax_gen_tmp$genus %in% tax_gen$genus) > 0) {
      toadd <- tax_gen_tmp[!tax_gen_tmp$genus %in% tax_gen$genus,]
      tax_gen <- tax_gen %>% add_row(toadd)
      rownames(tax_gen) <- tax_gen$genus
    }

    meta_tot <- meta_tot %>% add_row(meta) 
    rownames(meta_tot) <- meta_tot$ID

    # Check for identical order
    print(identical(colnames(feat_gen), rownames(meta_tot)))

    tax_gen <- tax_gen[match(rownames(feat_gen), tax_gen$genus), ]
    rownames(tax_gen) <- tax_gen$genus
    print(identical(rownames(tax_gen), rownames(feat_gen)))

    tse_full <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
      assays =  SimpleList(relabundance = feat_gen),
      colData = DataFrame(meta_tot),
      rowData = DataFrame(tax_gen)) 

    assays(tse_full)

    saveRDS(tse_full, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_genus_exp_allpipelines.rds"))

  }
}

#         With default tax (separate objects)          #

for (d in datasets$datasets) { 

  tse_list <- list()

  feat_gen <- data.frame(genus = character())
  tax_gen <- data.frame(kingdom = character(),
                        phylum = character(),
                        class = character(),
                        order = character(),
                        family = character(),
                        genus = character(),
                        species = character())
  meta_tot <- data.frame(
                        sample = character(),
                        pipeline = character(),
                        ID = character(),
                        primer=character(),
                        qc=character(),
                        denoising=character(),
                        chimera=character(),
                        merging=character(),
                        post=character(),
                        tax=character(),
                        db=character())



  for (p in pipelines) { 
  
    if (is.null(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["feat"]])) next

    feat <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][["feat"]] %>%
      select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>% as.matrix()

    if (!is.null(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["tax"]])) {
      tax <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][["tax"]]
      rn <- rownames(tax)
      tax <- sapply(colnames(tax), function(x) { gsub("^[a-z]__", "", tax[[x]]) }) %>% as.data.frame() # needed for idtaxa
      tax <- sapply(colnames(tax), function(r) {
          o <- tax[[r]]
          o[grepl("unclassified|NA|Incertae_Sedis|Incertae|uncultured|No hit|\\?", o)] <- NA
          return(o)
        }) %>% as.data.frame()
      rownames(tax) <- rn
    } else tax <- NULL

    meta <- data.frame(sample = colnames(feat),
                      pipeline = rep(p, ncol(feat))) 

    colnames(feat) <- paste0(p, "_", colnames(feat))
    rownames(meta) <- colnames(feat)
    meta$ID <- colnames(feat)
    meta <- meta %>%
        dplyr::left_join(., algorithms_df, by = "pipeline") # add algorithm information

    if (!is.null(tax)) {

      if (length(setdiff(rownames(feat), rownames(tax))) > 0) {
        warning(paste("Features in feat but not in tax for pipeline", p, "in dataset", d))
        diff <- setdiff(rownames(feat), rownames(tax))
        message(paste("Adding missing features ( n =", length(diff), ") to tax table with values NA for pipeline", p))
        diff_df <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = length(diff), ncol = ncol(tax)))
        colnames(diff_df) <- colnames(tax)
        rownames(diff_df) <- diff
        tax <- tax %>%
          rbind(diff_df)
      }

      if (length(setdiff(rownames(tax), rownames(feat))) > 0) {
        stop(paste("Features in tax but not in feat for pipeline", p, "in dataset", d))
      }

      feat <- feat[match(rownames(tax), rownames(feat), nomatch = 0), ] %>% as.matrix()
      colnames(feat) <- meta$ID
      print(identical(rownames(tax), rownames(feat)))

      tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
      assays =  SimpleList(counts = feat),
      colData = DataFrame(meta),
      rowData = DataFrame(tax))
    } else {
      tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
      assays =  SimpleList(counts = feat),
      colData = DataFrame(meta))
    }

    tse <- transformAssay(tse, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = 0)
    
    if (ncol(rowData(tse)) > 0) {
      altExp(tse, "genus") <- agglomerateByRank(tse, rank = "genus")
      rowData(altExp(tse, "genus"))$genus[rowData(altExp(tse, "genus"))$genus %in% c("NA", "uncultured", "Incertae_Sedis", "?")] <- NA
      rowData(altExp(tse, "genus"))$genus[grepl("unclassified", rowData(altExp(tse, "genus"))$genus)] <- NA 
    }

    tse_list[[p]] <- tse

  }

  saveRDS(tse_list, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_deftax_", d, "_allpipelines.rds"))

}
```

### Label TPs and FPs in TSE 
```{r label_tp, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

alloutput <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "all_tables_combined.rds"))

# ASV level
for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% reals]) {
  print(d)

  allprecision <- lapply(pipelines, function(p) {
      if (!is.null(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["precision"]])) {
      precision <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][["precision"]]
      precision$ID2 <- paste0(p, "_", precision$ID)
      precision$pipeline <- p
      precision
    }
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  # ASVs in combined tse
  tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", d, "_asv_allpipelines.rds"))
  
  rowData(tse)$tp <- case_when(
    rownames(tse) %in% allprecision$ID2[allprecision$reference %in% "Reference" & allprecision$mismatch == 0] ~ "TP",
    rownames(tse) %in% allprecision$ID2[allprecision$reference %in% "Reference" & allprecision$mismatch == 1] ~ "1MM",
    rownames(tse) %in% allprecision$ID2[allprecision$reference %in% "Silva" & allprecision$mismatch == 0] ~ "SILVA0",
    TRUE ~ "FP"
  )
  saveRDS(tse, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_tp", d, "_asv_allpipelines.rds"))

  # ASVs in separate tse
  for (c in classifiers) {
    tse_list <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_",c, "_", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))
    
    for (p in names(tse_list)) {
      tse_p <- tse_list[[p]]
      precision <- allprecision %>% filter(pipeline %in% p)

      rowData(tse_p)$tp <- case_when(
        rownames(tse_p) %in% precision$ID[precision$reference %in% "Reference" & precision$mismatch == 0] ~ "TP",
        rownames(tse_p) %in% precision$ID[precision$reference %in% "Reference" & precision$mismatch == 1] ~ "1MM",
        rownames(tse_p) %in% precision$ID[precision$reference %in% "Silva" & precision$mismatch == 0] ~ "SILVA0",
        TRUE ~ "FP"
      ) 
      tse_list[[p]] <- tse_p
    }
    
    saveRDS(tse_list, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_tp", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))
  }

  # To link it to the default tax
  tse_def <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_deftax_", d, "_allpipelines.rds"))
  for (p in pipelines) {
    if (is.null(tse_def[[p]])) next
    if (ncol(rowData(tse_def[[p]])) == 0) next
    
    tse_p <- tse_def[[p]]

    precision <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][["precision"]]
    rowData(tse_p)$tp <- case_when(
      rownames(tse_p) %in% precision$ID[precision$reference %in% "Reference" & precision$mismatch == 0] ~ "TP",
      rownames(tse_p) %in% precision$ID[precision$reference %in% "Reference" & precision$mismatch == 1] ~ "1MM",
      rownames(tse_p) %in% precision$ID[precision$reference %in% "Silva" & precision$mismatch == 0] ~ "SILVA0",
      TRUE ~ "FP"
    )
    tse_def[[p]] <- tse_p
  }

  saveRDS(tse_def, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_deftax_tp", d, "_allpipelines.rds"))

  # Genus level
  tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds"))
  
  for (c in classifiers) {
    tse_gen <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_genus_allpipelines.rds"))
    
    rowData(tse_gen)$tp <- case_when(
      rownames(tse_gen) %in% rowData(tse_exp)$genus ~ "TP",
      TRUE ~ "FP"
    )

    saveRDS(tse_gen, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_tp", d, "_genus_allpipelines.rds"))
  }
  
}
```

### Label TPs and FNs in TSE 
```{r label_fn, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

alloutput <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "all_tables_combined.rds"))
gen_fn <- list()

for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% reals]) {  
  tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds"))
  gen_exp <- unique(rowData(tse_exp)$genus)

  tse_q2 <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", "q2", "_", d, "_genus_allpipelines.rds"))
  tse_idtaxa <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", "idtaxa", "_", d, "_genus_allpipelines.rds"))

  gen_fn[[d]][["q2"]] <- data.frame(genus = gen_exp)  
  gen_fn[[d]][["idtaxa"]] <- data.frame(genus = gen_exp)

  for (p in pipelines) {
    print(paste("Dataset:", d, "| Pipeline:", p))
    # ASV level
    if (!is.null(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["recall"]])) {
      recall <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][["recall"]]

      recall$sequence.id <- stringr::str_replace_all(rownames(recall), "^[0-9]+_", "")

      if (d %in% "mock12") {
          recall$sequence.id <- str_split(recall$sequence.id, "_") %>% sapply(function(x) paste0(x[1], "_", x[2]))
      }

      fn_tp <- data.frame(sequence.id = unique(recall$sequence.id)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(!!paste0("fn_", p) := sapply(unique(recall$sequence.id), function(id) ifelse(all(is.na(recall$ASV_0_mismatch[recall$sequence.id == id])), "fn", "tp")))

      if (d %in% "mock12") {
        tax <- data.frame(rowData(tse_exp)) %>%
        mutate(sequence.id = stringr::str_replace_all(rownames(.), "^[0-9]+_", "")) %>%
        dplyr::left_join(fn_tp, by = "sequence.id") %>%
        select(-sequence.id) 
      } else {
        tax <- data.frame(rowData(tse_exp)) %>%
          rownames_to_column("sequence.id") %>%
          dplyr::left_join(fn_tp, by = "sequence.id") %>%
          column_to_rownames("sequence.id")
      }

      rowData(tse_exp) <- DataFrame(tax)
    }

    # Genus level
    for (c in classifiers) {
      tse_p <- get(paste0("tse_", c)) 
      tse_p <- tse_p[, tse_p$pipeline %in% p]
      tse_p <- tse_p[rowSums(assay(tse_p)) > 0, ] # only keep genera that are present
                             
      if (ncol(tse_p) > 0) {
        fn_tp <- data.frame(genus = gen_exp) %>%
                  mutate(!!paste0("fn_", p) := ifelse(gen_exp %in% rowData(tse_p)$genus, "tp", "fn"))

        gen_fn[[d]][[c]] <- gen_fn[[d]][[c]] %>%
          dplyr::left_join(fn_tp, by = "genus") 
      }
    
    } # c in classifiers
  } # p in pipelines

  saveRDS(tse_exp, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_fn_tp_", d, ".rds")) # ASV_level
  saveRDS(gen_fn, file = paste0(output_path, "genus_fn_tp_", d, ".rds")) # Genus level

} # d in datasets


```

# Feature-level performance
## Descriptive statistics
> Percentage of sequences lost (reads_out/reads_in * 100)
> Number of ASVs reports 
> Number of singleton sequences + percentage of ASV that is singleton  
> Numder of genera reports (default, qiime2, idtaxa)
> Feature table sparsity (%0)
> Percentage of features/sequences assigned to different taxonomic levels

```{r basic_stats, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

alloutput <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "all_tables_combined.rds"))

stats_sample <- list()
stats_dataset <- list() 

# Read length statistics 
rl <- read_tsv(read_length, col_names=TRUE) %>%
  mutate(formatted = paste0(Median, " [", Min, "-", Max, "]")) %>%
  select(Dataset, pipeline=Pipeline, read_length=formatted)

for (d in datasets$datasets) {

  df_dataset <- tibble(
    pipeline = character(),
    read_length = character(),
    !!!setNames(
      replicate(81, numeric(), simplify = FALSE),
      c(
        "reads_in", "reads_out", "reads_lost",
        "asv", "singletons", "sparsity",
        paste0("num_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus")),
        paste0("num_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), c("_idtaxa")),
        paste0("num_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), c("_q2")),
        paste0("num_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), c("_idtaxa_gg")),
        paste0("num_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), c("_q2_gg")),
        paste0("assigned_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus")),
        paste0("assigned_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), "_q2"),
        paste0("assigned_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), "_idtaxa"),
        paste0("assigned_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), "_q2_gg"),
        paste0("assigned_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), "_idtaxa_gg"),
        paste0("perc_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus")),
        paste0("perc_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), "_q2"),
        paste0("perc_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), "_idtaxa"),
        paste0("perc_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), "_q2_gg"),
        paste0("perc_", c("phylum","class","order","family","genus"), "_idtaxa_gg")
      )
    )
  )

  reads_in <- alloutput[[d]][["reads_in"]]
  rl_sub <- rl %>% filter(Dataset == d) %>% select(-Dataset)

  # Read tse into list 
  tse_list <- lapply(c(classifiers, "q2_gg", "idtaxa_gg"), function(t) {
    readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", t, "_", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))
  })
  names(tse_list) <- c("tse_q2", "tse_idtaxa", "tse_q2_gg", "tse_idtaxa_gg")
  tse_list[["tse"]] <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_deftax_", d, "_allpipelines.rds"))

  for (p in pipelines) {
    
    if (p %in% "Expected") next
    print(paste0("Dataset: ", d, " | Pipeline: ", p))

    tse <- tse_list[["tse"]][[p]]        
    if(is.null(tse)) next # if nonexistent, next
    tax <- rowData(tse) %>% data.frame()

    for (t in c(classifiers, "q2_gg", "idtaxa_gg")) {     

      temp <- tse_list[[paste0("tse_", t)]]
      temp <- temp[[p]]

      if (!is.null(temp)) {
        temp <- temp[rowSums(assay(temp), na.rm = TRUE) > 0, ]
        tax <- rowData(temp) %>% data.frame()
      } else if (is.null(temp)) {
        tax <- NULL
      } else if (ncol(temp) == 0) {
        temp <- NULL
        tax <- NULL
      }
      
      assign(paste0("tse_", t), temp) # assign to tse_q2 or tse_idtaxa
      assign(paste0("tax_", t), tax)
    }

    for (t in c("tse", "tse_q2", "tse_idtaxa", "tse_q2_gg", "tse_idtaxa_gg")) {
      temp <- get(t)

      if (!is.null(temp)) {
        temp_tax <- data.frame(rowData(temp))
        if (ncol(temp_tax) == 0) temp_tax <- NULL
      } else {
        temp_tax <- NULL
      }

      # remove uninformative taxonomic labels (set to NA so that they are not counted as assigned)
      if (!is.null(temp_tax)) {
        temp_tax$kingdom <- NULL # because this is missing for some pipelines
        temp_tax$domain <- NULL
        temp_tax$species <- NULL # because this is missing for most pipelines

        new_tax <- sapply(colnames(temp_tax), function(r) {
          o <- temp_tax[[r]]
          o[grepl("unclassified|NA|Incertae_Sedis|uncultured|No hit|\\?", o)] <- NA
          return(o)
        }) %>% data.frame(row.names = rownames(temp_tax))

        identical(rownames(new_tax), rownames(temp))
        rowData(temp) <- DataFrame(new_tax) # update tax in tse

        if (ncol(rowData(temp)) > 0) { 
          temp_allranks <- agglomerateByRanks(temp) # create separate object for each rank 
        } else {
          temp_allranks <- NULL
          temp_tax <- NULL
        }

        assign(t, temp) # update new asv table
        assign(paste0(t, "_allranks"), temp_allranks) # update new allranks object
        assign(gsub("tse", "tax", t), temp_tax) # update tax table
      } else {
        temp_allranks <- NULL
        temp_tax <- NULL
        assign(paste0(t, "_allranks"), temp_allranks) # update new allranks object
        assign(gsub("tse", "tax", t), temp_tax) # update tax table

      }
    }

    identical(tse_q2$sample, tse_idtaxa$sample)
    identical(tse_q2$sample, tse$sample)      
    
    nsamples <- length(colnames(tse))

    df_sample <- data.frame(sample_names=str_remove(colnames(tse), paste0(p, "_")),
                            asv = sapply(colnames(tse), function(x) sum(assay(tse)[,x] > 0)),
                            reads_out = colSums(assay(tse)),
                            num_genus_idtaxa = rep(NA, nsamples),
                            num_genus_q2 = rep(NA, nsamples),
                            num_genus_q2_gg = rep(NA, nsamples),
                            num_genus_idtaxa_gg = rep(NA, nsamples),
                            num_genus = rep(NA, nsamples)
                            ) %>%
            dplyr::left_join(., reads_in, by = "sample_names") %>%
            mutate(reads_lost = ((reads_in - reads_out) / reads_in) * 100)

    if (!is.null(tse_idtaxa_allranks))  df_sample <- df_sample %>% mutate(num_genus_idtaxa = sapply(colnames(tse), function(x) sum(assay(altExp(tse_idtaxa_allranks, "genus"))[,x] > 0)))
    if (!is.null(tse_q2_allranks))  df_sample <- df_sample %>% mutate(num_genus_q2 = sapply(colnames(tse), function(x) sum(assay(altExp(tse_q2_allranks, "genus"))[,x] > 0)))
    if (!is.null(tse_q2_gg_allranks))  df_sample <- df_sample %>% mutate(num_genus_q2_gg = sapply(colnames(tse), function(x) sum(assay(altExp(tse_q2_gg_allranks, "genus"))[,x] > 0)))
    if (!is.null(tse_idtaxa_gg_allranks))  df_sample <- df_sample %>% mutate(num_genus_idtaxa_gg = sapply(colnames(tse), function(x) sum(assay(altExp(tse_idtaxa_gg_allranks, "genus"))[,x] > 0)))
    if (!is.null(tse_allranks)) df_sample <- df_sample %>% mutate(num_genus = sapply(colnames(tse), function(x) sum(assay(altExp(tse_allranks, "genus"))[,x] > 0)))

    ## Calculate metrics
    # Define taxonomy ranks and methods
    ranks <- c("phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus")

    # Helper to count assigned %
    count_assigned <- function(tax_table, rank) {
      if (is.null(tax_table)) return(NA_real_)
      sum(!is.na(tax_table[[rank]])) / nrow(tax_table) * 100
    }

    perc_assigned <- function(reads_out, tse_all, rank) {
      if ( is.null(tse_all)) return(NA_real_)
      sum_rank <- sum(assay(altExp(tse_all, rank), "counts"), na.rm=TRUE)
      (sum_rank / reads_out) * 100
    }

    # Helper to count unique taxa in altExp
    count_unique_taxa <- function(tse_obj, rank) {
      if (is.null(tse_obj)) return(NA_real_)
      length(unique(rownames(altExp(tse_obj, rank))))
    }

    # Compute all metrics
    metrics <- list(
      pipeline = p,
      reads_in = sum(df_sample$reads_in),
      reads_out = sum(df_sample$reads_out),
      read_length = rl_sub$read_length[rl_sub$pipeline == p],
      asv = nrow(assay(tse)),
      singletons = sum(rowSums(assay(tse)) == 1),
      sparsity = sum(assay(tse) == 0) / (nrow(assay(tse)) * ncol(assay(tse))) * 100
    )
    metrics$reads_lost <- ((metrics$reads_in - metrics$reads_out) / metrics$reads_in) * 100

    # Add taxonomic assignment stats
    metrics <- c(
      metrics,
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ count_unique_taxa(tse_allranks, .x)), paste0("num_", ranks)),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ count_unique_taxa(tse_q2_allranks, .x)), paste0("num_", ranks, "_q2")),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ count_unique_taxa(tse_idtaxa_allranks, .x)), paste0("num_", ranks, "_idtaxa")),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ count_unique_taxa(tse_idtaxa_gg_allranks, .x)), paste0("num_", ranks, "_idtaxa_gg")),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ count_unique_taxa(tse_q2_gg_allranks, .x)), paste0("num_", ranks, "_q2_gg")),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ count_assigned(rowData(tse), .x)), paste0("assigned_", ranks)),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ count_assigned(tax_q2, .x)), paste0("assigned_", ranks, "_q2")),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ count_assigned(tax_idtaxa, .x)), paste0("assigned_", ranks, "_idtaxa")),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ count_assigned(tax_q2_gg, .x)), paste0("assigned_", ranks, "_q2_gg")),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ count_assigned(tax_idtaxa_gg, .x)), paste0("assigned_", ranks, "_idtaxa_gg")),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ perc_assigned(metrics$reads_out, tse_allranks, .x)), paste0("perc_", ranks)),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ perc_assigned(metrics$reads_out, tse_q2_allranks, .x)), paste0("perc_", ranks, "_q2")),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ perc_assigned(metrics$reads_out, tse_idtaxa_allranks, .x)), paste0("perc_", ranks, "_idtaxa")),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ perc_assigned(metrics$reads_out, tse_q2_gg_allranks, .x)), paste0("perc_", ranks, "_q2_gg")),
      set_names(map(ranks, ~ perc_assigned(metrics$reads_out, tse_idtaxa_gg_allranks, .x)), paste0("perc_", ranks, "_idtaxa_gg"))
    )

    # Add to df_dataset
    df_dataset <- df_dataset %>% add_row(!!!metrics)
    stats_sample[[d]][[p]] <- df_sample # add to list                 
  }

    stats_dataset[[d]] <- df_dataset # add to list
}


saveRDS(stats_sample, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample.rds"))
saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset.rds"))
```

### Average abundance
Extracting the range of average abundances 
```{r ave_ab, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

# ASV level
df <- list()

for (d in datasets$datasets) {

  suffix <- ifelse(d %in% reals, "", "tp")

  # ASV
  if (d %in% c(mocks, sims)) {
    tse <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", suffix, d, "_asv_allpipelines.rds"))
  } else {
    tse_249 <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", d, "_trim249_asv_allpipelines.rds")) 
  }

  # Genus
  # Q2
  tse_q2 <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", suffix, d, "_genus_allpipelines.rds"))
  if (!"relabundance" %in% assayNames(tse_q2)) tse_q2 <- transformAssay(tse_q2, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = FALSE)

  # IDTAXA
  tse_idtaxa <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_idtaxa_", suffix, d, "_genus_allpipelines.rds"))
  if (!"relabundance" %in% assayNames(tse_idtaxa)) tse_idtaxa <- transformAssay(tse_idtaxa, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = FALSE)

  # Default
  tse_def <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_deftax_", d, "_allpipelines.rds"))

  # Picrust2
  # KO
  tse_KO <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_KO_", d, "picrust_allpipelines.rds"))
  if (!"relabundance" %in% assayNames(tse_KO)) tse_KO <- transformAssay(tse_KO, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = FALSE)

  # MetaCyc
  tse_cyc <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_cyc_", d, "picrust_allpipelines.rds"))
  if (!"relabundance" %in% assayNames(tse_cyc)) tse_cyc <- transformAssay(tse_cyc, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = FALSE)

  for (tr in c("", "_def", "_q2", "_idtaxa", "_KO", "_cyc")) {    
    tmp <- get(paste0("tse", tr))    
    tr <- ifelse(tr == "", "asv", gsub("_", "", tr)) 

    if (d %in% reals & !tr %in% "def") {
      pips <- unique(tmp$pipeline)
      df_sum <- data.frame(assay(tmp, assay.type = "relabundance")) %>%
        mutate(
          !!!setNames(
            lapply(pips, function(p) {
              # select all columns starting with this pipeline tag
              cols <- dplyr::select(., dplyr::starts_with(p))
              # row-wise sum across those columns
              rowSums(as.matrix(cols), na.rm = TRUE)
            }),
            pips
          )
        ) %>% 
        dplyr::select(all_of(pips))

      rowData(tmp)$specific <- rowSums(df_sum > 0)
    }

    df[[d]][[tr]] <- data.frame(pipeline=character(), ab = numeric(), prev = numeric(), tp = character(), specific = numeric())
    noexp <- d %in% reals || tr %in% c("def", "KO", "cyc") # no expected abundance info available
    nospec <- !d %in% reals || tr %in% c("def")

    for (p in pipelines) {

      print(paste0(d, " - ", tr, " - ", p))
      # Subset based on pipeline
      if (tr %in% "def") {
        if (!is.null(tmp[[p]])) {
          if (ncol(rowData(tmp[[p]])) > 0) {
            tmp_sub <- altExp(tmp[[p]], "genus") 
          }
        } else {
           next
        }
      } else {
        tmp_sub <- tmp[, colData(tmp)$pipeline == p]
        tmp_sub <- tmp_sub[rowSums(assay(tmp_sub), na.rm=TRUE) > 0,]
      }

      if (is.null(tmp_sub) || nrow(tmp_sub) == 0) next

      if (!"relabundance" %in% assayNames(tmp_sub)) {
        tmp_sub <- transformAssay(tmp_sub, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = FALSE)
      }

      prev <- getPrevalence(tmp_sub)

      tp_var <- if (noexp) rep(NA, nrow(tmp_sub)) else rowData(tmp_sub)$tp
      specific_var <- if (nospec) rep(NA, nrow(tmp_sub)) else rowData(tmp_sub)$specific 

      df[[d]][[tr]] <- df[[d]][[tr]] %>%
        bind_rows(
          data.frame(
            pipeline = p,
            ab = rowMeans(assay(tmp_sub, "relabundance")),
            prev = prev,
            tp = tp_var,
            specific = specific_var
          )
        )                        
    }
  }
}

saveRDS(df, file = paste0(output_path, "abundance_distributions.rds"))
```

```{r ave_ab_fn, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}
df_list <- list()
df_all <- data.frame(pipeline = character(), dataset = character(), ab = numeric(), prev = numeric(), tp = character())

for (d in c(mocks, sims)) {

  for (p in pipelines) {

                     ab = numeric(), prev = numeric(), tp = character())

  for (d in c(mocks, sims)) {

    }

  df_list[[c]] <- df_all
```

> Number of MetaCyc pathways

```{r stats_picrust, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample.rds"))
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset.rds"))

# Number of features KO
# Number of features MetaCyc 

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  for (lev in c("KO", "cyc")) { # KO and MetaCyc

    df <- data.frame(pipeline = character(), num = numeric())
    tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", lev, "_", d, "picrust_list_allpipelines.rds"))

    for (p in pipelines) {

      print(paste(d, lev, p))
      
      if (!p %in% names(tse)) next
      if (p %in% "Expected") next # skip expected 

      tse_sub <- tse[[p]]

      # Sample level
      sample_count <- lapply(unique(tse_sub$sample), function(s) {
        fcount <- sum(assay(tse_sub)[, tse_sub$sample %in% s] > 0, na.rm=TRUE)
        fcount_rel <- sum(assay(tse_sub)[, tse_sub$sample %in% s] > 0, na.rm=TRUE) / nrow(tse_sub)
        data.frame(sample = s, num = fcount, rel = fcount_rel)
      }) %>% bind_rows()

      colnames(sample_count) <- c("sample_names", paste0("num_", lev), paste0("rel_", lev))

      stats_sample[[d]][[p]] <- stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>%
        dplyr::left_join(., sample_count, by = "sample_names")

      # Dataset level
      fcount <- sum(rowSums(assay(tse_sub), na.rm=TRUE) > 0)
      df <- df %>% 
        add_row(data.frame(pipeline = p, num = fcount))

    }

  colnames(df) <- c("pipeline", paste0("num_", lev))
  stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(., df, by = "pipeline")   

  }
}
```

## Feature-level Recall and Precision
### ASV-level Recall
Recall reflects the proportion of sequences that were correctly
identified by a pipeline among all true sequences (TP/(TP + FN)).

```{r recall_seq, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

alloutput <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "all_tables_combined.rds"))
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust.rds"))
stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust.rds"))

for (d in c(mocks, sims)) {

  tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds")) 

  # Remove prefix number > each sequence ID has several sequences linked to them
  seqid <- stringr::str_replace_all(rownames(tse_exp), "^[0-9]+_", "")   
  
  # initialize empty dataframe to store results
  df_recall <- data.frame(sequence.id = seqid)
  df_recall_1mm <- data.frame(sequence.id = seqid)

  for (p in pipelines) {
    #####################  Per pipeline ########################################### 
    if (is.null(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["recall"]])) next
    
    print(paste0("Dataset: ", d, " | Pipeline: ", p))

    recall <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][["recall"]]
    recall$sequence.id <- stringr::str_replace_all(rownames(recall), "^[0-9]+_", "")
    
    if (d %in% "mock12") {
      recall$sequence.id <- str_split(recall$sequence.id, "_") %>% sapply(function(x) paste0(x[1], "_", x[2]))
    }

    # for each seq id, check if there was a perfect match for pipeline p (for any of the matching sequences)
    df_recall[[p]] <- sapply(df_recall$sequence.id, function(id) ifelse(all(is.na(recall$ASV_0_mismatch[recall$sequence.id == id])), 0, 1))
    df_recall_1mm[[p]] <- sapply(df_recall$sequence.id, function(id) {
      ifelse(all(is.na(recall$ASV_0_mismatch[recall$sequence.id == id])) & 
             all(is.na(recall$ASV_1_mismatch[recall$sequence.id == id])), 0, 1)
    })

    #####################  Per sample ########################################### 
    feat <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][["feat"]] %>%
            select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

    recallrate_sample <- data.frame(sample_names = character(), recallrate = numeric(), recallrate_1mm = numeric())

    for (s in colnames(feat)) {
      feat_sub <- feat[, grepl(s, colnames(feat)), drop=FALSE]
      feat_sub <- feat_sub %>% filter(!!sym(s) > 0) # Remove absent ASVs from df

      exp_sub <- assay(tse_exp)[, grepl(s, colnames(assay(tse_exp))), drop=FALSE] 
      exp_sub <- names(exp_sub[exp_sub > 0,]) %>% str_replace_all(., "^[0-9]+_", "")

      recall_sub <- recall[recall$sequence.id %in% exp_sub, ]

      nomm <- sapply(unique(recall_sub$sequence.id), function(id) {
        if (any(!is.na(recall_sub$ASV_0_mismatch[recall_sub$sequence.id == id]))) {
          asv_ls <- c(recall_sub$ASV_0_mismatch[recall_sub$sequence.id == id]) %>% str_split(";") %>% unlist()
          ifelse(any(asv_ls %in% rownames(feat_sub)), 1, 0)    
        } else 0
      })
      
      recall_0mm <- sum(nomm) / length(exp_sub)

      onemm <- sapply(unique(recall_sub$sequence.id), function(id) {
        if (any(!is.na(recall_sub$ASV_0_mismatch[recall_sub$sequence.id == id])) | 
            any(!is.na(recall_sub$ASV_1_mismatch[recall_sub$sequence.id == id]))) {
          asv_ls <- c(recall_sub$ASV_0_mismatch[recall_sub$sequence.id == id], recall_sub$ASV_1_mismatch[recall_sub$sequence.id == id]) %>% str_split(";") %>% unlist()
          ifelse(any(asv_ls %in% rownames(feat_sub)), 1, 0)    
        } else 0
      })
      
      recall_1mm <- sum(onemm) / length(exp_sub)
      
      recallrate_sample <- recallrate_sample %>%
        add_row(sample_names = s, recallrate = recall_0mm, recallrate_1mm = recall_1mm)
       
    }

    stats_sample[[d]][[p]] <- stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(recallrate_sample, by = "sample_names")

  }

  recallrate <- data.frame(pipeline = pipelines, 
                           recallrate = sapply(pipelines, function(p) sum(df_recall[[p]]) / nrow(df_recall)),
                           recallrate_1mm = sapply(pipelines, function(p) sum(df_recall_1mm[[p]] == 1) / nrow(df_recall_1mm)))


  stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(., recallrate, by = "pipeline")

}

saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall.rds"))
saveRDS(stats_sample, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall.rds"))

```

### ASV-level Precision
Precision reflects the proportion of true positives among all positives
(TP/(TP+FP))

```{r precision_seq, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

alloutput <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "all_tables_combined.rds"))
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall.rds"))
stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall.rds"))

for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% reals]) {

  precision_df <- data.frame(pipeline = character(),
                             precisionrate = numeric(),
                             precisionrate_1mm = numeric(),
                             asv_tp = numeric(),
                             asv_1mm = numeric())

  tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds")) 

  for (p in pipelines) {
    #####################  Per pipeline ########################################### 
    if (is.null(alloutput[[d]][[p]][["precision"]])) next
    
    print(paste0("Dataset: ", d, " | Pipeline: ", p))

    precision <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][["precision"]]
    precisionrate <- sum(precision$reference %in% "Reference" & precision$mismatch == 0) / nrow(precision)
    precisionrate_1mm <- sum(precision$reference %in% "Reference" & (precision$mismatch == 0 | precision$mismatch == 1)) / nrow(precision)
    asv_tp <- sum(precision$reference %in% "Reference" & precision$mismatch == 0)
    avs_1mm <- asv_tp + sum(precision$reference %in% "Reference" & precision$mismatch == 1)

    precision_tmp <- data.frame(pipeline=p, precisionrate=precisionrate, precisionrate_1mm=precisionrate_1mm, asv_tp=asv_tp, asv_1mm = avs_1mm)
    precision_df <- precision_df %>% dplyr::add_row(precision_tmp)

    #####################  Per sample ########################################### 
    precision_tp <- precision %>% filter(reference %in% "Reference" & mismatch == 0)
    precision_1mm <- precision %>% filter(reference %in% "Reference" & (mismatch == 0 | mismatch == 1))

    precisionrate_sample <- data.frame(sample_names = character(), precisionrate = numeric(), precisionrate_1mm = numeric())

    feat <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][["feat"]] %>%
            select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))
    
    for (s in colnames(feat)) {
      feat_sub <- feat[, grepl(s, colnames(feat)), drop=FALSE]
      feat_sub <- feat_sub[rowSums(feat_sub) > 0, , drop=FALSE]

      exp_sub <- assay(tse_exp)[, grepl(s, colnames(assay(tse_exp))), drop=FALSE] 
      exp_sub <- names(exp_sub[exp_sub > 0,]) %>% str_replace_all(., "^[0-9]+_", "") 

      precision_tp_sub <- precision_tp[precision_tp$tax %in% exp_sub,]
      precision_1mm_sub <- precision_1mm[precision_1mm$tax %in% exp_sub,]

      # Zero mismatches
      nomm <- sapply(rownames(feat_sub), function(id) {
        ifelse(id %in% precision_tp_sub$ID, 1, 0)
      })

      precisionrate <- sum(nomm) / nrow(feat_sub)

      # One mismatch
      onemm <- sapply(rownames(feat_sub), function(id) {
        ifelse(id %in% precision_1mm_sub$ID, 1, 0)
      })

      precisionrate_1mm <- sum(onemm) / nrow(feat_sub)

      precisionrate_sample <- precisionrate_sample %>%
        add_row(sample_names = s, precisionrate = precisionrate, precisionrate_1mm = precisionrate_1mm)

    }

    stats_sample[[d]][[p]] <- stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(precisionrate_sample, by = "sample_names")
  }
  
  stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(precision_df, by = "pipeline")

}

saveRDS(stats_sample, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision.rds"))
saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision.rds"))

for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% reals]) {
  print(d)
  for (p in pipelines) {
    print(p)
    if (any(grepl("rate", colnames(stats_sample[[d]][[p]])))) {
    stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% select(contains("rate")) %>% summary() %>% print()
    }
  } 
}

```

### Genus-level recall and precision
For both classifiers (q2 and idtaxa) using silva reference

```{r recall_seq_g, eval=FALSE,include=TRUE}

alloutput <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "all_tables_combined.rds"))
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision.rds"))
stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision.rds"))

# recall_df <- data.frame(pipeline = pipelines)
# precision_df <- data.frame(pipeline = pipelines)
TPs <- data.frame(pipeline = character(), dataset=character(), genus = character())
FNs <- data.frame(pipeline = character(), dataset=character(), genus = character())
FPs <- data.frame(pipeline = character(), dataset=character(), genus = character())

TP_mat <- list()

for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% reals]) {

  tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds")) 
  exp_gen <- unique(rowData(tse_exp)$genus)

  TP_mat[[d]] <- list(q2 = data.frame(genus = exp_gen), 
                 idtaxa = data.frame(genus = exp_gen))

  precision_recall_df <- data.frame(pipeline = character(),
                                    precisionrate_genus_q2 = numeric(),
                                    recallrate_genus_q2 = numeric(),
                                    genus_tp_q2 = numeric(),
                                    precisionrate_genus_idtaxa = numeric(),
                                    recallrate_genus_idtaxa = numeric(),
                                    genus_tp_idtaxa = numeric())

  tse_q2 <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", d, "_genus_allpipelines.rds"))
  tse_idtaxa <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_idtaxa_", d, "_genus_allpipelines.rds"))

  for (p in pipelines) {

    print(paste("Dataset:", d, "| Pipeline:", p))

    new_row_dataset <- list(pipeline=p)
    precision_recall_s_q2 <- data.frame(sample_names = character(), 
                                       precision_gen_q2 = numeric(), 
                                       recall_gen_q2 = numeric()) 
    precision_recall_s_idtaxa <- data.frame(sample_names = character(), 
                                       precision_gen_idtaxa = numeric(), 
                                       recall_gen_idtaxa = numeric())   

    if (!p %in% tse_q2$pipeline) next                                   

    for (c in classifiers) {
      
      tse_tmp <- get(paste0("tse_", c))

      # Per pipeline
      tse_sub <- tse_tmp[, tse_tmp$pipeline %in% p]

      gen <- rownames(tse_sub)[rowSums(assay(tse_sub)) > 0] %>% unique()

      recall <- sum(exp_gen %in% gen) / length(exp_gen) # TP / (TP + FN)
      precision <- sum(gen %in% exp_gen) / length(gen) # TP / (TP + FP)

      TP <- intersect(exp_gen, gen) # true positive
      FN <- setdiff(exp_gen, gen) # false negative
      FP <- setdiff(gen, exp_gen) # false positive

      genus_tp <- length(TP) # number of tp genera

      TP_mat[[d]][[c]][[p]] <- exp_gen %in% gen # for visualization

      TPs <- rbind(TPs, data.frame(pipeline = rep(p, length(TP)), dataset = rep(d, length(TP)), classifier = rep(c, length(TP)), genus = TP))
      FNs <- rbind(FNs, data.frame(pipeline = rep(p, length(FN)), dataset = rep(d, length(FN)), classifier = rep(c, length(FN)), genus = FN))
      FPs <- rbind(FPs, data.frame(pipeline = rep(p, length(FP)), dataset = rep(d, length(FP)), classifier = rep(c, length(FP)), genus = FP))
      
      # Create new row to add to df at end of loop
      new_row_dataset[[paste0("precisionrate_genus_", c)]] <- precision
      new_row_dataset[[paste0("recallrate_genus_", c)]] <- recall
      new_row_dataset[[paste0("genus_tp_", c)]] <- genus_tp
    
      # Per sample            
      for (s in colnames(tse_sub)) {
        
        tse_s <- tse_sub[,s]
        tse_s <- tse_s[rowSums(assay(tse_s)) > 0,]

        gen_s <- rownames(tse_s) %>% unique()

        tse_exp_s <- tse_exp[, grepl(tse_s$sample[1], colnames(tse_exp))]
        tse_exp_s <- tse_exp_s[rowSums(assay(tse_exp_s))>0,]

        exp_gen_s <- rowData(tse_exp_s)$genus %>% unique()

        recall_s <- sum(exp_gen_s %in% gen_s) / length(exp_gen_s)
        precision_s <- sum(gen_s %in% exp_gen_s) / length(gen_s)

        if (c %in% c("q2")) {
          precision_recall_s_q2 <- precision_recall_s_q2 %>%
            add_row(sample_names = tse_s$sample[1], precision_gen_q2 = precision_s, recall_gen_q2 = recall_s)
        } else if (c %in% "idtaxa") {
          precision_recall_s_idtaxa <- precision_recall_s_idtaxa %>%
            add_row(sample_names = tse_s$sample[1], precision_gen_idtaxa = precision_s, recall_gen_idtaxa = recall_s)
        }
      }
    }
    
    precision_recall_df <- precision_recall_df %>% dplyr::add_row(!!!new_row_dataset) # add dataset-level infromation to df

    stats_sample[[d]][[p]] <- stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(precision_recall_s_q2, by = "sample_names") %>%
      dplyr::left_join(precision_recall_s_idtaxa, by = "sample_names")

  } 

  stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(precision_recall_df, by = "pipeline")

}

# Compile stats for later reference
FP_stats <- list(tp_mat = TP_mat, FP = FPs, FN = FNs, TP = TPs)

saveRDS(FP_stats, file = paste0(output_path, "FP_stats_pipelines_datasets.rds"))
saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus.rds"))
saveRDS(stats_sample, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus.rds"))

```

#### Manual genus-level recall/precision check
NGTax seemed to have relatively low precision relative to other pipelines. 
Given differences in the way NGTax outputs sequences (2*7-bp unmerged) we calculated recall/precision with the defautl classifier.
This was meant to rule out large differences in q2/idtaxa estimated preformance vs. default classifier performance

```{r recall_ngtax, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus.rds"))
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_wrecall_wprecision_genus.rds"))

df <- data.frame(dataset = character(), 
                 recall_def = numeric(),
                 recall_q2 = numeric(),
                 recall_idtaxa = numeric(),
                 precision_def = numeric(),
                 precision_q2 = numeric(),
                 precision_idtaxa = numeric())

FP_all <- data.frame(genus=character(), dataset=character())
FN_all <- FP_all

exp_list <- list()
obs_list <- list()

for (d in c(mocks, sims)) {
  
  tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds"))
  exp_v <- rowData(tse_exp)$genus %>% unique()
  
  tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_deftax_", d, "_allpipelines.rds"))
  tse_sub <- tse[["NGTax2"]]

  obs <- data.frame(genus = rowData(tse_sub)$genus %>% unique()) %>%
    filter(!is.na(genus)) %>% 
    mutate(TP = genus %in% exp_v)

  exp <- data.frame(genus = rowData(tse_exp)$genus %>% unique()) %>%
    filter(!is.na(genus)) %>% 
    mutate(TP = genus %in% obs$genus)

  FP <- obs %>% arrange(genus) %>% filter(!TP)
  FN <- exp %>% filter(!TP) %>% arrange(genus)

  if (nrow(FP) > 0) {
    FP_all <- FP_all %>%
      bind_rows(data.frame(genus = FP$genus, dataset = d)) 
  }

  if (nrow(FN) > 0) {
    FN_all <- FN_all %>%
      bind_rows(data.frame(genus = FN$genus, dataset = d)) 
  }

  recall <- sum(exp$TP) / nrow(exp)
  precision <- sum(obs$TP) / nrow(obs)

  # Q2 classification
  df2 <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    filter(pipeline %in% "NGTax2") %>% 
    select(recall_q2 = recallrate_genus_q2, precision_q2=precisionrate_genus_q2,
           recall_idtaxa = recallrate_genus_idtaxa, precision_idtaxa=precisionrate_genus_idtaxa) %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)

  newrow <- data.frame(dataset = d,
                      recall_def=recall,
                      precision_def=precision) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(., df2, by = "dataset")

  df <- df %>% 
    add_row(newrow)

  exp_list[[d]] <- exp
  obs_list[[d]] <- obs

}

df %>% select(all_of(contains("precision"))) %>% tibble()
df %>% select(all_of(contains("recall"))) %>% tibble()

write_tsv(FP_all, paste0(output_path, "FP_NGTax_def.tsv"))
write_tsv(FN_all, paste0(output_path, "FN_NGTax_def.tsv"))

tse_def <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_deftax_", d, "_allpipelines.rds"))

## Recalculate recall / precision after reference check
FN_check <- read_tsv(paste0(output_path, "FN_NGTax_def_check.tsv"))
FP_check <- read_tsv(paste0(output_path, "FP_NGTax_def_check.tsv"))

df2 <- data.frame(dataset = character(), recall_def2=numeric(), precision_def2=numeric())

for (d in c(mocks, sims)) {
  obs <- obs_list[[d]]
  exp <- exp_list[[d]] 

  obs2 <- obs %>%
    filter(!genus %in% FP_check$genus[FP_check$in_reference == FALSE])

  exp2 <- exp %>% 
    filter(!genus %in% FN_check$genus[FN_check$in_reference == FALSE])

  recall2 <- sum(exp2$TP) / nrow(exp2)
  precision2 <- sum(obs2$TP) / nrow(obs2)

  df2 <- df2 %>% 
    bind_rows(data.frame(dataset=d, recall_def2=recall2, precision_def2=precision2))

}

df_all <- df %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., df2, by = "dataset")

df_all %>% select(all_of(contains("precision"))) %>% tibble()
df_all %>% select(all_of(contains("recall"))) %>% tibble()

plt <- df_all %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols=-dataset, names_to="variable", values_to="value") %>%
  mutate(metric = ifelse(grepl("recall", variable), "recall", "precision")) %>%
  mutate(classifier = sapply(str_split(variable, "_"), tail, 1)) %>%
  mutate(classifier = factor(classifier, levels = c("def", "def2", "q2", "idtaxa"),
                                         labels = c("Default", "Default (check)", "Q2-NBC", "IDTAXA"))) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c(mocks, sims))) %>%

    geom_point(size = 2, position=position_dodge(0.4)) +
    my_theme(theme_bw) + 
    facet_wrap(~metric) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(x = "", y = "recall/precision")

ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "SFigure_recall_ngtax.pdf"), 
      plot = plt, device = cairo_pdf, width = 5, height = 3)
```

### Read-weighted precision
The %TP reads / total observed
Both ASV-level and Genus-level
```{r perc_tp, eval=FALSE,include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus.rds"))

# Precision/Recall (% reads, ASV)
for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% reals]) {
  tse <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_tp", d, "_asv_allpipelines.rds"))

  perc_reads       <- data.frame(pipeline = character(),
                                 perc_tp_precision = numeric(),
                                 perc_1mm_precision = numeric(),
                                 perc_fp = numeric())

  for (p in pipelines) {

    tse_sub <- tse[, grepl(p, colnames(tse))]
    tse_sub <- tse_sub[rowSums(assay(tse_sub), na.rm = TRUE) > 0, ]
    if (ncol(tse_sub) == 0) next

    # tse_sub <- transformAssay(tse_sub, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = FALSE)

    perc_tp <- sum(assay(tse_sub, "counts")[rowData(tse_sub)$tp %in% "TP",]) / sum(assay(tse_sub, "counts")) * 100
    # print(paste("Dataset:", d, "| Pipeline:", p, "| % reads TP:", round(perc_tp, 2)))
    
    perc_fp <- sum(assay(tse_sub, "counts")[rowData(tse_sub)$tp %in% c("FP", "SILVA0"),]) / sum(assay(tse_sub, "counts")) * 100

    perc_1mm <- sum(assay(tse_sub, "counts")[rowData(tse_sub)$tp %in% c("1MM"),]) / sum(assay(tse_sub, "counts")) * 100
    # print(paste("Dataset:", d, "| Pipeline:", p, "| % reads TP/1MM:", round(perc_1mm, 2)))

    perc_reads <- perc_reads %>%
      add_row(pipeline = p,
              perc_tp_precision = perc_tp,
              perc_1mm_precision =  perc_1mm,
              perc_fp = perc_fp)
  }

  print(paste("Dataset:", d))
  
  perc_reads %>% arrange(desc(perc_tp)) %>% tibble() %>% print()

  stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
    dplyr::left_join(perc_reads, by = "pipeline")

}

# Precision/Recall (% reads, genus)
for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% reals]) {
  for (c in classifiers) {

    tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_asv_allpipelines.rds"))
    assay(tse, "counts")[is.na(assay(tse, "counts"))] <- 0

    tse <- tse[!is.na(rowData(tse)$genus), ]
    tse <- transformAssay(tse, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = FALSE)
    tse_gen <- agglomerateByRank(tse, rank = "genus")
    
    tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds"))
    exp_gen <- unique(rowData(tse_exp)$genus)
    
    feat <- assay(tse_gen, "relabundance") %>% as.data.frame()
    tp_gen <- ifelse(rowData(tse_gen)$genus %in% exp_gen, "TP", "FP")

    feat_tp <- sapply(unique(tp_gen), function(x) colSums(feat[tp_gen == x, ])) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "ID") 

    tab <- data.frame(colData(tse)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(feat_tp, , by = "ID") %>%
      filter(!pipeline %in% c("Expected")) %>%
      group_by(pipeline) %>%
      summarise(perc_tp_precision = mean(TP)*100, perc_fp = mean(FP)*100)

    colnames(tab) <- c("pipeline", paste0("perc_tp_precision_", c), paste0("perc_fp_", c))

    stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
      dplyr::left_join(tab, by = "pipeline")

    print(paste("Dataset:", d, "| Classifier:", c))
    print(tibble(tab))

  } 
}

saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctp.rds"))
```

### Read-weighted recall
The %TP abundance / total expected abundance (total = 1)
Both ASV-level and Genus-level

```{r fn, eval=FALSE,include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctp.rds"))

for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% reals]) {

  tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_fn_tp_", d, ".rds")) # ASV_level with TP/FN overview
  gen_c <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "genus_fn_tp_", d, ".rds")) # Genus level TP/FN overview

  fn_perc_df <- data.frame(pipeline = character(),
                     tp_perc_recall = numeric(),
                     fn_perc = numeric(),
                     fn_perc_gen_q2 = numeric(),
                     fn_perc_gen_idtaxa = numeric(),
                     tp_perc_gen_recall_q2 = numeric(),
                     tp_perc_gen_recall_idtaxa = numeric())

  for (p in pipelines) {
    
    if (all(!grepl(p, colnames(rowData(tse))))) next

    status_col <- paste0("fn_", p)
    tot_count <- sum(assay(tse), na.rm = TRUE)
    tp_count <- sum(assay(tse)[rowData(tse)[[status_col]] == "tp",], na.rm = TRUE)
    fn_count <- sum(assay(tse)[rowData(tse)[[status_col]] == "fn",], na.rm = TRUE)

    fn_perc <- fn_count / tot_count * 100 
    tp_perc <- tp_count / tot_count * 100

    for (c in classifiers) {
       gen <- gen_c[[d]][[c]] 

       gen_fn <- gen$genus[gen[[status_col]] == "fn"]
       gen_tp <- gen$genus[gen[[status_col]] == "tp"]

       fn_count_genus <- sum(assay(tse)[rowData(tse)$genus %in% gen_fn,], na.rm = TRUE)
       fn_perc_gen <- fn_count_genus / tot_count * 100 
       assign(paste0("fn_perc_gen_", c), fn_perc_gen)

       tp_count_genus <- sum(assay(tse)[rowData(tse)$genus %in% gen_tp,], na.rm = TRUE)
       tp_perc_gen <- tp_count_genus / tot_count * 100 
       assign(paste0("tp_perc_gen_recall_", c), tp_perc_gen)

    }

    fn_perc_df <- fn_perc_df %>%
      add_row(pipeline = p,
              tp_perc_recall = tp_perc,
              fn_perc = fn_perc,
              fn_perc_gen_q2 = fn_perc_gen_q2,
              fn_perc_gen_idtaxa = fn_perc_gen_idtaxa,
              tp_perc_gen_recall_q2 = tp_perc_gen_recall_q2,
              tp_perc_gen_recall_idtaxa = tp_perc_gen_recall_idtaxa)

  }

  stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(fn_perc_df, by = "pipeline")

  print(paste("Dataset:", d))
  print(tibble(fn_perc_df))

  print(fn_perc_df$tp_perc_gen_recall_q2 + fn_perc_df$fn_perc_gen_q2)
  
}

saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp.rds"))
```

### Picrust-level recall and precision picrust 
Both KO and MetaCyc pathways 

```{r recall_precision_picrust, eval=FALSE,include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp.rds"))
stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus.rds"))

df <- data.frame(pipeline = character(), num = numeric())
    
for (lev in c("KO", "cyc")) {
  tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", lev, "_exp_simulation.rds"))
  exp_d <- rownames(tse_exp)

  for (d in sims) {

    df_dataset <- data.frame(pipeline = character(), recall=numeric(), precision=numeric()) 
    tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", lev, "_", d, "picrust_list_allpipelines.rds"))

    for (p in pipelines) {

      print(paste(lev, d, p))

      if (!p %in% names(tse)) next 
      if (p %in% "Expected") next
    
      tse_sub <- tse[[p]]

      # Per dataset
      obs_d <- rownames(tse_sub)
      recall <- sum(exp_d %in% obs_d) / length(exp_d) 
      precision <- sum(obs_d %in% exp_d) / length(obs_d) 

      df_dataset <- df_dataset %>%
        add_row(data.frame(pipeline = p, recall = recall, precision = precision))

      # Per sample
      df_sample <- lapply(unique(tse_sub$sample), function(s) {
        obs <- assay(tse_sub)[, tse_sub$sample %in% s]
        obs <- names(obs)[obs > 0]
        
        exp <- assay(tse_exp)[, tse_exp$sample %in% s]
        exp <- names(exp)[exp > 0]

        recall <- sum(exp %in% obs) / length(exp) 
        precision <- sum(obs %in% exp) / length(obs)

        data.frame(sample_names = s, recall = recall, precision = precision)  
      }) %>% bind_rows()
      colnames(df_sample) <- c("sample_names", paste0("recall_", lev), paste0("precision_", lev))

      # Add to stats_sample
      stats_sample[[d]][[p]] <- stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>%
        dplyr::left_join(., df_sample, by = "sample_names")
    
    }

    # Add to stats_dataset
    colnames(df_dataset) <- c("pipeline", paste0("recall_", lev), paste0("precision_", lev))
    stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(., df_dataset, by = "pipeline") 

  }
}

saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall.rds"))
saveRDS(stats_sample, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))

```

## Similarity/Dissimilarity 
The main outcome metric to quantify similarity in real communities (consensus) is Jaccard (%overlapping features)
As an additional metric Aitchison Distance is also calculated to quantify abundance-weighted distance

### Pairwise distance
Pairwise distances (Jaccard) is calculated in permanova.sh / permanova.R (due to runtime). Run first.
Here we extract the average (consensus) within-sample between-pipeline Jaccard similarity

Variables calculated: 
> distave_{mydist}_{c} (all datasets)
> distexp_{mydist}_{c} (ground truth datasets)

```{r pair_dist, eval=TRUE,include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall.rds"))
# distlist <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "hclust_distance_matrices.rds"))
distlist <- list()

pairwise_sample_mean <- function(pipe_i, pipe_j) {
        # Get indices for each pipeline (rows for i, columns for j)
        idx_i <- which(pipe_names == pipe_i)
        idx_j <- which(pipe_names == pipe_j)  # since symmetric
        
        dists <- mat[idx_i, idx_j] %>% as.data.frame() %>%
          rownames_to_column(var = "sample_i") %>%
          pivot_longer(-sample_i, names_to = "sample_j", values_to = "distance") %>%
          mutate(sample_i = gsub(paste0(pipe_i, "_"), "", sample_i),
                sample_j = gsub(paste0(pipe_j, "_"), "", sample_j)) %>%
          filter(sample_i == sample_j)  # only keep matching sample pairs
        
        mean(dists$distance, na.rm = TRUE)
}

for (mydist in c("jaccard")) {  
  for (d in datasets$datasets) {
    for (c in c("asv", "asv249", "q2", "q2_gg", "idtaxa", "idtaxa_gg", "deftax", "KO", "cyc")) { 

      print(paste("Processing", mydist, d, c))

      level <- case_when(
        grepl("asv", c) ~ "asv",
        c %in% c("q2", "idtaxa", "q2_gg", "idtaxa_gg", "deftax") ~ "genus",
        c %in% c("KO", "cyc") ~ "picrust"
      )
      trim <- ifelse(grepl("asv", c), gsub("asv", "", c), "")
      if (trim %in% "_exp") trim <- ""

      if ((level %in% c("genus") || c %in% "asv") & !d %in% reals & !grepl("_gg|deftax", c)) {
        level <- c(level, "exp") 
      } else if (level %in% c("picrust") & d %in% sims) {
        level <- c(level, "exp") 
      }

      for (lev in level) {

        if (c %in% "asv" & lev %in% "exp") {
          c <- "asv_exp"
          m_save <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "dist_mds_", mydist, "_", d, "_asv_exp.rds"))
        } else if (grepl("asv", c)) {
          m_save <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "dist_mds_", mydist, "_", d, "_", lev, trim, ".rds"))
        } else if (c %in% c("q2", "idtaxa", "q2_gg", "idtaxa_gg", "deftax")) {
           m_save <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "dist_mds_", c, "_", mydist, "_", d, "_", lev, ".rds"))
        } else if (c %in% c("KO", "cyc") & !lev %in% "exp") {
          m_save <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "dist_mds__", mydist, "_", d, "_", c, ".rds"))
        } else if (c %in% c("KO", "cyc") & lev %in% "exp") {
          m_save <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "dist_mds_", c, "_", mydist, "_", d,  "_exp.rds"))  
        }
  
        mat <- m_save$mat %>% as.matrix()
        colnames(mat) <- rownames(mat) <- gsub("_mock12", "", rownames(mat))

        samp_names <- gsub(paste(paste0(c("Expected", pipelines), "_"), collapse = "|"), "", rownames(mat))
        n_samp <- length(unique(samp_names))

        patterns <- paste0(c("Expected", pipelines), collapse = "|")  # "pipeline1|pipeline2|...|pipeline14"
        pipe_names <- gsub(paste0("^(.*(", patterns, "))(.*)$"), "\\1", rownames(mat))
        unique_pipelines <- unique(pipe_names)
        n_pipe <- length(unique(pipe_names))
      
        if (d %in% "mock12") {
          pip_dist_mat <- mat # Only one sample, so no need for averaging
        } else {
          # Build pipeline distance matrix (same as before)      
          pip_dist_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n_pipe, n_pipe, 
                                dimnames = list(unique_pipelines, unique_pipelines))

          for (i in seq_along(unique_pipelines)) {
            for (j in seq_along(unique_pipelines)) {
              pip_dist_mat[i, j] <- pairwise_sample_mean(unique_pipelines[i], unique_pipelines[j])
            }
          }
        }

        pip_dist <- as.dist(pip_dist_mat) # this matrix contains the pairwise distances 
        distlist[[mydist]][[lev]][[d]][[c]] <- pip_dist  

        # pip_dist_mat <- distlist[[mydist]][[lev]][[d]][[c]] %>% as.matrix()
        rownames(pip_dist_mat) <- colnames(pip_dist_mat) <- gsub(paste0("_", d), "", rownames(pip_dist_mat))   
        
        # Save the average pairwise distances
        # Average between-pipeline (always calculate)
        if (!lev %in% "exp") {
          diag(pip_dist_mat) <- NA
          df_add <- data.frame(pipeline = colnames(pip_dist_mat),
                              avg = rowMeans(pip_dist_mat, na.rm=TRUE))
          colnames(df_add)[2] <- paste0("distave_", mydist, "_", c)
          
          stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
            dplyr::left_join(., df_add, by = "pipeline")
        } else {
          # Only select the distance between pipelines and expected
          df_add <- data.frame(pip_dist_mat) %>% 
            select(Expected) %>%
            rownames_to_column(var="pipeline") %>% 
            filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected")
          
          colnames(df_add)[2] <- paste0("distexp_", mydist, "_", c)
          
          stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
            dplyr::left_join(., df_add, by = "pipeline")
        }
        
      } # level 
    } # feature type
  } # datasets
} # distance metric

# convert to simularities + keep jaccard 
jaccard_feature <- rapply(distlist[["jaccard"]],
                  function(x) {
                    m <- 1 - as.matrix(x)
                    diag(m) <- 1   # a pipeline is 100% similar to itself
                    m
                  },
                  classes = "dist", how = "replace")

get_list_names(jaccard_feature) %>% print()
save(jaccard_feature, file = paste0(output_path, "jaccard_feature.RData"))
saveRDS(distlist, file = paste0(output_path, "hclust_distance_matrices.rds"))

colnames(stats_dataset[[d]])
saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds.rds"))
saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm.rds"))
```
