## Correlation
Average between pipeline & correlation to expected
Corrlations calculated in cor_pip.R / cor_pip.sh 

```{r feat_cor, eval=TRUE,include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm.rds"))
levels <- c("asv", "asv249", "asv_exp", "q2", "idtaxa", "q2_gg", "idtaxa_gg", "KO", "cyc", "deftax") 
transformations <- c("relabundance", "clr", "log")

# Compile correlations into single data.frame
cor_all <- data.frame(pipeline = character(),
                      dataset = character(),
                      prev_filt = character(),
                      transformation = character(),
                      feat = character(),
                      cor = numeric(),
                      cor_intersection = numeric(),
                      exp = character())

mat_all <- list()

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  for (c in levels) {

    if (c %in% c("q2", "idtaxa") & !d %in% reals) { 
      levs <- c("consensus", "exp")
    } else if (c %in% c("KO", "cyc") & d %in% sims) {
      levs <- c("consensus", "exp")
    } else if (c %in% "asv_exp") {
      if (d %in% reals) next
      levs <- c("exp")
    } else {
      levs <- c("consensus")
    }

    myfile <- paste0(output_path, "cor_list", c, "_", d, ".rds")
    if (!file.exists(myfile)) {
      next
      message(paste(myfile, "does not exist"))
    }

    cor_list <- readRDS(file = myfile)
    
    avg_corr <- cor_list$avg_corr # union correlation
    avg_intersection_corr <- cor_list$avg_intersection_corr # intersection correlation

    for (l in levs) {
      if (l %in% "consensus") {

        # Define pipelines to remove (due to uneven read length)
        if (c %in% "asv") {
          pipeline_remove <- c("Expected", "NGTax2", "AMPtk", "LotuS2", "LotuS2_otu", "QIIME2Deblur") # have different seq lengths 
        } else if (c %in% "asv199") {
          pipeline_remove <- c("Expected", "NGTax2")
        } else if (c %in% "asv249") {
          pipeline_remove <- c("Expected", "NGTax2", "LotuS2", "LotuS2_otu")
        } else {
          pipeline_remove <- c("Expected")
        }
      
        p2 <- "all"
        for (t in transformations) {

          print(paste("Processing dataset:", d, "feat:", c, "transformation:", t, "expected: ", l))

          cormat <- avg_corr[[p2]][[d]][[c]][[t]]
          diag(cormat) <- NA
          
          if (!is.null(pipeline_remove)) {
            p2_remove <- colnames(cormat)[colnames(cormat) %in% pipeline_remove]
            if (length(p2_remove) > 0) {
              cormat <- data.frame(cormat) %>% 
                filter(!rownames(.) %in% p2_remove) %>% 
                select(-all_of(p2_remove))
            }
          }

          cor_sub <- data.frame(avg = rowMeans(cormat, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline")
          
          corintersectionmat <- avg_intersection_corr[[p2]][[d]][[c]][[t]]
          diag(corintersectionmat) <- NA
          if (!is.null(pipeline_remove)) {
            if (length(p2_remove) > 0) {
              corintersectionmat <- data.frame(corintersectionmat) %>% 
                filter(!rownames(.) %in% p2_remove) %>% 
                select(-all_of(p2_remove))
            }
          }  

          corintersection_sub <- data.frame(avg = rowMeans(corintersectionmat, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline")

          mat_all[[d]][[c]][[t]][["cor"]] <- cormat
          mat_all[[d]][[c]][[t]][["cor_intersection"]] <- corintersectionmat

          # Combine in df 
          df <- data.frame(pipeline = cor_sub$pipeline,
                                      dataset = d,
                                      prev_filt = p2,
                                      transformation = t,
                                      feat = c,
                                      cor = cor_sub$avg,
                                      cor_intersection = corintersection_sub$avg,
                                      exp = "consensus")
          
          # add to big df (for plotting later)
          cor_all <- add_row(cor_all, df)

          # Add df to stats_dataset
          df_add <- df %>% 
            select(pipeline, cor, cor_intersection)
          colnames(df_add) <- c("pipeline", paste0("cor_", t, "_", c), paste0("corintersection_", t, "_", c))

          stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
            dplyr::left_join(., df_add, by = "pipeline")
        } # transformations

      } else {
        
        for (t in transformations) {

          print(paste("Processing dataset:", d, "feat:", c, "transformation:", t, "expected: ", l))

          c2 <- c
          if (c %in% "asv_exp") c2 <- "asv"
          
          cormat <- avg_corr[[p2]][[d]][[c2]][[t]] %>%
            data.frame() %>% 
            select("Expected") %>% 
            rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline") %>% 
            filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected")
 
          corintersectionmat <- avg_intersection_corr[[p2]][[d]][[c2]][[t]] %>% 
            data.frame() %>% 
            select("Expected") %>% 
            rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline") %>% 
            filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected")

          identical(cormat$pipeline, corintersectionmat$pipeline)

          # Combine in df 
          df <- data.frame(pipeline = cormat$pipeline,
                                      dataset = d,
                                      prev_filt = p2,
                                      transformation = t,
                                      feat = c,
                                      cor = cormat$Expected,
                                      cor_intersection = corintersectionmat$Expected,
                                      exp = "expected")
          
          # add to big df (for plotting later)
          cor_all <- add_row(cor_all, df)

          # Write to stats_dataset
          df_add <- data.frame(cormat) %>% select(pipeline, cor = Expected) %>%
            dplyr::left_join(., data.frame(corintersectionmat) %>% select(pipeline, cor_union = Expected), by = "pipeline")

          colnames(df_add) <- c("pipeline", paste0("cor_", t, "_", "exp_", c2), paste0("corintersection_", t, "_", "exp_", c2))  
          stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
            dplyr::left_join(., df_add, by = "pipeline")

        } # transformations
      } # if consensus, else

    } # levels
  } # feature level
} # dataset

saveRDS(cor_all, paste0(output_path, "cor_df.rds"))
saveRDS(mat_all, paste0(output_path, "cor_mat.rds"))
saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor.rds"))

abundance_correlations <- mat_all
get_list_names(abundance_correlations) %>% print()
save(abundance_correlations, file = paste0(output_path, "correlation_abundance.RData"))
```

## Classifiers and reference databases
### Between classifier/reference concordance
```{r tax_conc, eval=FALSE,include=TRUE}

concordance <- data.frame(dataset = character(),
                          pipeline = character(),
                          comb = character(),
                          phylum = numeric(),
                          class = numeric(),
                          order = numeric(),
                          family = numeric(),
                          genus = numeric(),
                          na1 = numeric(),
                          na2 = numeric(),
                          partial = numeric(),
                          mismatch = numeric())

alloverlaps <- list()

# Helper: taxonomy table from a TSE
get_tax <- function(tse) {
  if (is.null(tse)) return(NULL)
  tax <- sapply(colnames(rowData(tse)), function(x) gsub(" ", "_", rowData(tse)[[x]])) %>% data.frame()
  tax$kingdom <- NULL
  tax$domain <- NULL
  tax$species <- NULL
  tax
}

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  tse_q2        <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", "q2", "_", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))
  tse_idtaxa    <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", "idtaxa", "_", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))
  tse_q2_gg     <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", "q2_gg", "_", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))
  tse_idtaxa_gg <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", "idtaxa_gg", "_", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))
  tse_def       <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_deftax_", d, "_allpipelines.rds"))

  for (p in pipelines) {

    print(paste(d, "|", p))

    if (is.null(tse_def[[p]])) next

    # Object names must match the parts of `comb` split on "_" (e.g. "q2.gg" -> tax_q2.gg)
    tax_def       <- get_tax(tse_def[[p]])
    tax_q2        <- get_tax(tse_q2[[p]])
    tax_idtaxa    <- get_tax(tse_idtaxa[[p]])
    tax_q2.gg     <- get_tax(tse_q2_gg[[p]])
    tax_idtaxa.gg <- get_tax(tse_idtaxa_gg[[p]])

    # Check
    identical(rownames(tax_def), rownames(tax_q2))
    identical(rownames(tax_q2), rownames(tax_idtaxa))
    identical(rownames(tax_q2), rownames(tax_q2.gg))
    identical(rownames(tax_idtaxa), rownames(tax_idtaxa.gg))

    for (comb in c("def_q2", "def_idtaxa", "q2_idtaxa",      # between classifiers (SILVA)
                   "q2_q2.gg", "idtaxa_idtaxa.gg", "q2.gg_idtaxa.gg")) {  # between references (SILVA vs. Greengenes2)
      perc_overlap <- data.frame(dataset = d,
                                pipeline = p,
                                comb = comb,
                                phylum = NA,
                                class = NA,
                                order = NA,
                                family = NA,
                                genus = NA,
                                na1 = 0,
                                na2 = 0,
                                partial = 0,
                                mismatch = 0)

      clas1 <- (str_split(comb, "_") %>% unlist())[1]
      clas2 <- (str_split(comb, "_") %>% unlist())[2]

      tax1 <- get(paste0("tax_", clas1))
      tax2 <- get(paste0("tax_", clas2))

      # Skip combinations where one of the classifications is missing for this pipeline
      if (is.null(tax1) | is.null(tax2)) next

      # Align ASVs (row order may differ between classifications)
      shared <- intersect(rownames(tax1), rownames(tax2))
      tax1 <- tax1[shared, , drop = FALSE]
      tax2 <- tax2[shared, , drop = FALSE]

      for (n in colnames(tax1)) {
        tmp <- data.frame(clas1 = tax1[[n]],
                          clas2 = tax2[[n]])

        tmp$conc <- ifelse((is.na(tax1[[n]]) & !is.na(tax2[[n]])) | (is.na(tax2[[n]]) & !is.na(tax1[[n]])), FALSE, tax1[[n]] == tax2[[n]])
        tmp$conc[(is.na(tax1[[n]]) & is.na(tax2[[n]]))] <- TRUE

        perc_overlap[[n]][1] <- sum(tmp$conc) / length(tmp$conc)

        tmp_sub <- tmp %>% filter(conc == FALSE)

        if (n %in% "genus" & nrow(tmp_sub) > 0) {
          tmp_sub$mismatch_reason <- case_when(
            is.na(tmp_sub$clas1) & !is.na(tmp_sub$clas2) ~ "na1",
            is.na(tmp_sub$clas2) & !is.na(tmp_sub$clas1) ~ "na2",
            sapply(1:nrow(tmp_sub), function(n) grepl(tmp_sub$clas1[n], tmp_sub$clas2[n], fixed = TRUE)) ~ "partial",
            sapply(1:nrow(tmp_sub), function(n) grepl(tmp_sub$clas2[n], tmp_sub$clas1[n], fixed = TRUE)) ~ "partial",
            TRUE ~ "mismatch")

          reason_props <- summary(factor(tmp_sub$mismatch_reason)) / nrow(tmp_sub)

          perc_overlap$na1[1] <- ifelse("na1" %in% names(reason_props), reason_props["na1"], 0)
          perc_overlap$na2[1] <- ifelse("na2" %in% names(reason_props), reason_props["na2"], 0)
          perc_overlap$partial[1] <- ifelse("partial" %in% names(reason_props), reason_props["partial"], 0)
          perc_overlap$mismatch[1] <- ifelse("mismatch" %in% names(reason_props), reason_props["mismatch"], 0)

          alloverlaps[[d]][[p]][[comb]][[n]] <- list(conc = tmp, disconc = tmp_sub)
        } else {
          alloverlaps[[d]][[p]][[comb]][[n]] <- list(conc = tmp)
        }

      }

      concordance <- concordance %>%
        add_row(perc_overlap)
    }
  }
}

concordance <- concordance %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets)) %>%
  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines))

alloverlaps[["concordance"]] <- concordance

saveRDS(alloverlaps, file = paste0(output_path, "concordance_taxonomy.rds"))

# for publication
concordance_classify <- alloverlaps
get_list_names(concordance_classify)
save(concordance_classify, file = paste0(output_path, "concordance_classify.RData"))
```

# Statistical performance
## Add metadata to tse  
```{r prep_metadata, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% mocks]) { 

  # Add more sample information (group label etc)
    meta_new <- read_tsv(file = datasets$meta[datasets$datasets %in% d], col_names = TRUE)
    
    if (d %in% "parkinson") {
      meta_new$label <- factor(meta_new$health_status, levels = c("Control", "Parkinsons"), labels = c("Controls", "Parkinsons"))
      meta_new$sample <- meta_new$run_accession
      meta_new$sex <- factor(meta_new$sex, levels = c("male", "female"), labels = c("Male", "Female"))
      meta_new <- meta_new %>% select(sample, label, sex, age)
    } else if (d %in% "gemsim") {
      meta_new$sample <- meta_new$sample_names
      meta_new$label <- factor(meta_new$labels, levels = c("C", "P"), labels = c("Controls", "MS"))
      meta_new$sex <- factor(meta_new$sex, levels = c("M", "V"), labels = c("Male", "Female"))
      meta_new <- meta_new %>% select(-labels, -sample_names, -new_sample_names)
    } else if (d %in% "mindset") {
      meta_new$sample <- gsub("-", "", meta_new$feces)
      meta_new$label <- factor(meta_new$group, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Controls", "Psychiatric Condition"))
      meta_new <- meta_new %>% select(sample, label, sex=Gender, age, numdiag, paste0("RC", 1:4))
      meta_new$sex <- factor(meta_new$sex, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Male", "Female"))
      meta_new$age <- round(meta_new$age)
    } else if (d %in% sims) {
      meta_new$sample <- meta_new$sample_names
      meta_new$label <- factor(meta_new$labels, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Group 1", "Group 2"))
      meta_new <- meta_new %>% select(-labels, -sample_names)
    } 

  # add new meta for all existing TSEs
  for (c in c("asv", "q2", "idtaxa", "deftax")) {

    print(paste(d, "|", c))

    if (c %in% "asv") {
      if (d %in% sims) {
        tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_tp", d, "_asv_allpipelines.rds"))
      } else {
        tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", d, "_asv_allpipelines.rds"))
      }

      meta <- data.frame(colData(tse)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(., meta_new, by = "sample")

      print(tibble(meta)) # check 
      print(meta$label)

      colData(tse) <- DataFrame(meta)
      saveRDS(tse, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", d, "_asv_meta_allpipelines.rds"))

    } else if (c %in% classifiers) {
      if (d %in% sims) {
        tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_genus_exp_allpipelines.rds"))
      } else {
        tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_genus_allpipelines.rds"))
      }

      meta <- data.frame(colData(tse)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(., meta_new, by = "sample")

      print(tibble(meta)) # check 
      meta$label

      colData(tse) <- DataFrame(meta)
      saveRDS(tse, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_genus_meta_allpipelines.rds"))
    } else {
      tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_deftax_", d, "_allpipelines.rds")) 
      new_tse <- list()
      
      for (p in names(tse)) {
        if (p %in% "APSCALE") next # no deftax
        tse_tmp <- altExp(tse[[p]], "genus")
        
        meta <- data.frame(colData(tse_tmp)) %>%
          dplyr::left_join(., meta_new, by = "sample")

        print(tibble(meta)) # check 

        colData(tse_tmp) <- DataFrame(meta)
        new_tse[[p]] <- tse_tmp
      }
      saveRDS(new_tse, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_deftax_", d, "_meta_allpipelines.rds"))

    }
  }
}
```

## Alpha diversity
### Calculate Alpha metrics
Calculate alpha diversity and save in new tse
```{r alpha_calc, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% mocks]) { 
  for (c in c("asv")) { # , classifiers, "deftax"  

    print(paste(d, "|", c))
    if (c %in% "asv") {
      tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", d, "_asv_meta_allpipelines.rds")) 
    } else if (c %in% classifiers) {
      tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_genus_meta_allpipelines.rds"))
    } 

    data.frame(colData(tse)) %>% filter(pipeline %in% "DADA2") %>% group_by(label) %>% tally()

    dim(tse) %>% print()
    tse <- tse[, !is.na(tse$label)] # remove samples without labels
    dim(tse) %>% print()

    atype <- ifelse(d %in% sims & c %in% classifiers, "relabundance", "counts")
    # tse <- addAlpha(tse, assay.type = atype, index=c("observed_richness", "shannon_diversity"))
    
    tse <- addAlpha(tse, assay.type = atype,
                          index = c("observed_richness", "chao1_richness", "hill_richness", "ace_richness", # richness
                                    "camargo_evenness", "simpson_evenness", "pielou_evenness", "evar_evenness", "bulla_evenness", # evenness
                                    "simpson_lambda_dominance", "relative_dominance", "dmn_dominance", "gini_dominance", "core_abundance_dominance", "dbp_dominance", "absolute_dominance", # dominance
                                    "shannon_diversity", "log_modulo_skewness_diversity", "inverse_simpson_diversity", "gini_simpson_diversity", "fisher_diversity", "coverage_diversity")) # diversity

    if (c %in% "asv") {
      saveRDS(tse, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", d, "_asv_meta_alpha_allpipelines.rds"))
    } else {
      saveRDS(tse, file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_genus_meta_alpha_allpipelines.rds"))
    }

  }
}
```

### Run statistical models
```{r alpha_stat, eval=TRUE,include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor.rds"))
stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))

allmods <- list()

for (d in c(sims, reals)) {

  print(d)

  tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", d, "_asv_meta_alpha_allpipelines.rds"))
  meta <- data.frame(colData(tse))

  # Calculate alpha for expected communities (sim)
  if (d %in% sims) {
    tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds"))
    tse_exp <- addAlpha(tse_exp, assay.type = "relabundance", index=c("observed_richness", "shannon_diversity"))
    
    meta_sub <- meta %>% select(sample, label) %>% unique()
    meta_exp <- data.frame(colData(tse_exp)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(., meta_sub, by = "sample") # add group label
    
    meta <- meta %>%
      add_row(meta_exp)
  }

  var <- ifelse(d %in% "mindset", "RC1", "label")

  # Extract meta into long format 
  meta_long <- meta %>%
    select(pipeline, all_of(var), observed_richness, shannon_diversity) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c("observed_richness", "shannon_diversity"), 
                 names_to = "index",
                 values_to = "diversity") %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = rev(pipelines)),
           index = factor(index, levels = c("observed_richness", "shannon_diversity"), 
                                 labels = c("Observed Richness", "Shannon Diversity")))
  

  # Linear regression (alpha ~ var) 
  # Run the models 
  allmods[[d]][["mods"]] <- lapply(unique(meta$pipeline), function(pip) {
    lapply(c("observed_richness", "shannon_diversity"), function(a) {
      meta_sub <- meta %>% 
        filter(pipeline %in% pip) 
      meta_sub[[a]] <- scale(meta_sub[[a]])
      myformula <- paste(a, "~", var)
      mod <- glm(myformula, data = meta_sub, family = "gaussian") %>% 
            summ(., confint=TRUE, scale=FALSE) %>% 
            .$coeftable %>% 
            as.data.frame() %>% .[2,] %>%
            mutate(pipeline = pip, alpha = a, mod = myformula)
      return(mod)
    }) %>% bind_rows()
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  colnames(allmods[[d]][["mods"]]) <- c("est", "CIl", "CIh", "t", "p", "pipeline", "alpha", "mod")
  rownames(allmods[[d]][["mods"]]) <- NULL
  
  allmods[[d]][["mods"]] <- allmods[[d]][["mods"]] %>% mutate(col = ifelse(pipeline %in% "Expected", "exp", 
                                                ifelse(alpha %in% "observed_richness", "obs", 
                                                "shan")))
  allmods[[d]][["meta"]] <- meta_long
  
  # Add to stats_dataset 
  df_stat <- allmods[[d]][["mods"]] %>% 
    select(pipeline, est, alpha)

  ave_exp <- allmods[[d]][["mods"]] %>% 
    select(pipeline, est, alpha) %>% 
    filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>% 
    group_by(alpha) %>% 
    summarize(ave_est = mean(est, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  if (d %in% sims) {
    ave_exp$exp_est <- NA
    for (a in unique(ave_exp$alpha)) {
      exp_est <- df_stat %>% 
        filter(alpha %in% a, pipeline %in% "Expected") %>%
        pull(est)

      ave_exp$exp_est[ave_exp$alpha %in% a] <- exp_est
    }

    # Add distance to expected to stats_dataset
    df_add <- df_stat %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(., ave_exp, by = "alpha") %>%
      mutate(alpha_exp = est - exp_est,
             alpha = ifelse(grepl("observed", alpha), "observed", "shannon")) %>%
      select(pipeline, alpha, exp=alpha_exp) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = alpha,
                  values_from = c(exp), 
                  names_glue = "alpha_{alpha}_{.value}")
    
    stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
     dplyr::left_join(., df_add, by = "pipeline")
  } 

  # Add distance to average to stats_dataset
  df_add <- df_stat %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(., ave_exp, by = "alpha") %>%
    mutate(alpha_ave = est - ave_est,
            alpha = ifelse(grepl("observed", alpha), "observed", "shannon")) %>%
    select(pipeline, alpha, est, ave=alpha_ave) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = alpha,
                values_from = c(ave, est), 
                names_glue = "alpha_{alpha}_{.value}")

  stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(., df_add, by = "pipeline")
}

saveRDS(allmods, file = paste0(output_path, "alpha_models_lm.rds"))
saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha.rds"))

alpha_stats <- allmods
get_list_names(alpha_stats) %>% print()

save(alpha_stats, file = paste0(output_path, "alpha_stats.RData"))
```

### Assess inflation/deflation
```{r alpha_inflation, eval=TRUE,include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha.rds"))
pltlist <- list()

for (d in sims) { 

  tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", d, "_asv_meta_alpha_allpipelines.rds"))
  meta <- colData(tse) %>% data.frame()

  # Calculate alpha for expected communities (sim)
  tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds"))
  tse_exp <- addAlpha(tse_exp, assay.type = "relabundance", index=c("observed_richness", "shannon_diversity"))

  # Correlate expected to observed diversity/richness  
  for (a in c("observed_richness", "shannon_diversity")) {
    meta_sub <- meta %>% select(sample, label) %>% unique()
    
    meta_exp <- data.frame(colData(tse_exp)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(., meta_sub, by = "sample") %>% 
      select(sample, pipeline, all_of(a))
    
    meta_wide <- meta %>%
      add_row(meta_exp) %>% 
      select(sample, pipeline, {{a}}) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = pipeline, values_from = .data[[a]]) %>%
      column_to_rownames("sample")

  pip_cor <- cor(meta_wide) %>% data.frame() %>% 
    select(Expected) %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline") %>% 
    filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected")
  colnames(pip_cor)[2] <- paste0(a,"_inflation")

  stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(., pip_cor, by = "pipeline")

  # Vizualize 
  meta_exp <- data.frame(colData(tse_exp)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(., meta_sub, by = "sample") %>% 
    select(sample, Expected={{a}})
  meta_long <- meta %>% 
    select(sample, pipeline, all_of(a)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(., meta_exp, by="sample") %>%
    mutate(delta=.data[[a]]-Expected) %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines))


  pltlist[[d]][[a]] <- meta_long %>% 
  #  filter(!pipeline %in% "VSEARCH") %>% 
    ggplot(., aes(x = Expected, y=.data[[a]], color=pipeline, fill = pipeline)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      labs(x = paste("Expected", a), y = a, title = a) +
      theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5))

  }
}
```

## Beta Diversity
### Compile statistical models
Permanovas ran in separate script: permanova_group.sh / permanova_group.R

```{r beta_div, eval=TRUE,include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2.rds"))
allperm <- list()

for (d in c(sims, reals)) {
  for (mydist in c("aitchison", "jaccard")) {
    allperm[[mydist]][[d]] <- lapply(c("asv"), function(c) {
      
      # Check if file exists
      if (!file.exists(paste0(output_path, "permanova_group_", d, "_", c, ".rds"))) {
        print(paste("No file:", d, c))
        next
      }

      var <- ifelse(d %in% "mindset", "RC1", "label")
      perm <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "permanova_group_", d, "_", c, ".rds"))
      perm <- perm[[mydist]][[var]]

      # Check if file contains statistics
      if (length(perm) == 0) print(paste("Empty list:", d, c))

      # Cat all sumstats
      combined <- lapply(names(perm), function(p) {
        perm[[p]][["permanova"]] %>% 
          data.frame() %>% 
          .[1,] %>%
          mutate(pipeline = p,
                classifier = c)
      }) %>% bind_rows()
    }) %>% bind_rows()

    rownames(allperm[[mydist]][[d]]) <- NULL
    colnames(allperm[[mydist]][[d]]) <- c("df", "SS", "R2", "F", "p", "pipeline", "classifier")
    allperm[[mydist]][[d]]$pipeline <- factor(allperm[[mydist]][[d]]$pipeline, levels = pipelines)

    print(paste(mydist, d))
    tibble(allperm[[mydist]][[d]]) %>% print()

    # Add to stats_dataset
    # Only add distance to expected for simulated datasets
    if (d %in% sims) {
      exp <- allperm[[mydist]][[d]] %>% filter(pipeline %in% "Expected") %>% pull(R2)
      df_add <- data.frame(pipeline = allperm[[mydist]][[d]]$pipeline,
                          beta_exp = allperm[[mydist]][[d]]$R2 - exp) 
      colnames(df_add) <- c("pipeline", paste0("beta_", mydist, "_exp"))

      stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
       dplyr::left_join(., df_add, by = "pipeline")
    }

    # Always add distance to average
    ave <- mean(allperm[[mydist]][[d]]$R2)
    df_add <- data.frame(pipeline = allperm[[mydist]][[d]]$pipeline, 
                        beta_r2 = allperm[[mydist]][[d]]$R2,
                        beta_ave = allperm[[mydist]][[d]]$R2 - ave) 

    colnames(df_add) <- c("pipeline", paste0("beta_", mydist, "_R2"), paste0("beta_", mydist, "_ave"))

    stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
      dplyr::left_join(., df_add, by = "pipeline")

  }
}
```

## Differential abundance
### Create the statistical models 
```{r da_stats, eval=FALSE,include=TRUE}

df <- <- data.frame(est = numeric(),
                SE = numeric(),
                stat = numeric(),
                pval = numeric(),
                padj = numeric(),
                genus = character(),
                pipeline = character(),
                classifier = character(),
                dataset = character(),
                fam = character())

for (d in c(sims, reals)) {
  for (c in c("deftax", classifiers)) {

    if (c %in% classifiers) {
      tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_genus_meta_allpipelines.rds"))
    } else {
      tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_meta_allpipelines.rds"))
    }

    for (pip in pipelines) {

      print(paste(d, "|", c, "|", pip))

      if (c %in% "deftax") {
        if (is.null(tse[[pip]])) next
        tse_sub <- tse[[pip]]
        tse_sub <- transformAssay(tse_sub, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount=0)
        tse_sub <- subsetByPrevalent(tse_sub, assay.type = "relabundance", detection = 0, prevalence = 0.1)
        tse_sub <- transformAssay(tse_sub, assay.type = "relabundance", method = "clr", pseudocount=TRUE)
      } else {
        tse_sub <- tse[, tse$pipeline %in% pip]
        if (ncol(tse_sub) == 0) next 
        tse_sub <- tse_sub[rowSums(assay(tse_sub), na.rm = TRUE) > 0, ] # remove absent genera from tse
        if (!assayNames(tse_sub) %in% "relabundance") tse_sub <- transformAssay(tse_sub, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount=0)
        tse_sub <- subsetByPrevalent(tse_sub, assay.type = "relabundance", detection = 0, prevalence = 0.1)
        tse_sub <- transformAssay(tse_sub, assay.type = "relabundance", method = "clr", pseudocount=TRUE)
      }

      meta <- data.frame(colData(tse_sub))
      asv <- t(assay(tse_sub, "clr")) %>% data.frame() %>% mutate(ID = colData(tse_sub)$ID)  
      genera <- setdiff(colnames(asv), "ID")
      meta_asv <- meta %>%
        dplyr::left_join(asv, by = "ID")

      # Main model (genus as outcomes)
      var <- ifelse(d %in% "mindset", "RC1", "label")
      allmods <- lapply(genera, function(x) { 
          meta_asv[[x]] <- scale(meta_asv[[x]])
          myformula <- paste(x, "~", var)
          lm(formula = myformula, 
              data = meta_asv) %>% summ(., scale = TRUE, digits = 5) %>% 
          .$coeftable %>% 
          as.data.frame() %>% 
          .[2,] %>%
          mutate(genus = x,
                pipeline = pip,
                classifier = c,
                dataset = d, 
                fam = "gaussian")
      }) %>% bind_rows()

      rownames(allmods) <- NULL
      colnames(allmods) <- c("est", "SE", "stat", "pval", "genus", "pipeline", "classifier", "dataset", "fam")
      allmods$padj <- p.adjust(allmods$pval, method = "BH") # FDR correction using BH
      df <- bind_rows(df, allmods) # bind to df 

    }
  }
}

da_stats <- list(df = df) 
saveRDS(da_stats, file = paste0(output_path, "differential_abundance_stats.rds"))
```

### Compare DA statistics across pipelines
```{r da_compare, eval=TRUE, include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta.rds"))
da_stats <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "differential_abundance_stats.rds"))
df_comb <- da_stats$df

genus_coverage <- list()
all_mats <- list() # to store all correlation matrices 
all_df <- list() # to store all summary statistics and derivatives (e.g, proportion significance)

p_thres <- 0.05

for (d in c(sims, reals)) {
  for (c in c(classifiers, "def")) {
    print(paste("Dataset:", d, "| Classifier:", c))

    df <- df_comb %>% filter(dataset %in% d, grepl(c, classifier)) %>% unique()

    mean_est <- df %>%
      group_by(genus) %>%
      summarise(mean_est = mean(est, na.rm=TRUE)) 

    # Calculate difference from average effect size 
    df <- df %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(mean_est, by = "genus") %>%
      mutate(est_diff = est - mean_est)

    # Number of pipelines testing a genus 
    genus_coverage[[d]] <- df %>%
      filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>% 
      group_by(genus) %>%
      summarise(
        n_pipelines = n_distinct(pipeline),
        pipelines = paste(unique(pipeline), collapse = ";")
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(n_pipelines))

    table(genus_coverage[[d]]$n_pipelines)  # Distribution

    # Genera tested in any pipeline
    genera_union <- genus_coverage[[d]] %>%  # before: common_genera > change into genera_union
      pull(genus)

    # Genera tested in all pipelines 
    genera_intersection <- genus_coverage[[d]] %>%  # before: all_genera > change into genera_interactions (tested in all)
      filter(n_pipelines == length(unique(df$pipeline))) %>% 
      pull(genus)

    # Create filtered dataset
    df_union <- df %>% filter(genus %in% genera_union) %>% unique()
    df_intersection <- df %>% filter(genus %in% genera_intersection) %>% unique()

    # Count the number of significant associations per pipeline
    gencount <- df_union %>%
      group_by(pipeline) %>%
      summarize(da_n_tested = n(), da_n_sig=sum(padj < p_thres)) %>%
      mutate(da_perctested_sig = da_n_sig / da_n_tested)
    
    colnames(gencount) <- c("pipeline", paste0(colnames(gencount)[-1], "_", c))

    stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(., gencount, by = "pipeline")

    ################################################################
    # Calculate between-pipeline correlation in summary statistics #
    ################################################################
    matrices <- list() # object to store cor matrices / jaccard matrix

    # extract effect sizes and t-statistics
    sumstat_matrix <- lapply(c("est", "stat"), function(s) { 
      df_union %>%
        select(genus, pipeline, all_of(s)) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = pipeline, values_from = .data[[s]]) %>%
        column_to_rownames("genus")
    })
    
    names(sumstat_matrix) <- c("est", "stat") 
    
    # number of genera tested in both (intersection correlation)
    matrices[["overlap_n"]] <- t(!is.na(sumstat_matrix$est)) %*% (!is.na(sumstat_matrix$est)) 

    matrices[["cormat_est_intersection"]] <- cor(sumstat_matrix$est, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson") 
    matrices[["cormat_stat_intersection"]] <- cor(sumstat_matrix$stat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")

    # If not identified (with prevalence > 10%) set effect size and statistic to 0 (union correlation)
    sumstat_matrix[["est"]][is.na(sumstat_matrix[["est"]])] <- 0
    sumstat_matrix[["stat"]][is.na(sumstat_matrix[["stat"]])] <- 0

    matrices[["cormat_est"]] <- cor(sumstat_matrix$est, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson") # union
    matrices[["cormat_stat"]] <- cor(sumstat_matrix$stat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson") # union
    
    ##################################################################
    # Calculate between-pipeline jaccard of significant associations #
    ##################################################################
    
    # Jaccard of significant findings (padj < p_thres) 
    sumstat_matrix[["sig"]] <- df_union %>%
      mutate(significant = padj < p_thres) %>%
      select(genus, pipeline, significant) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = pipeline, values_from = significant) %>%
      column_to_rownames("genus")

    # Overlap between all genera (considered n.s. if not tested) >> union set
    mat <- sumstat_matrix[["sig"]]
    matrices[["jaccard"]] <- outer(1:ncol(mat), 1:ncol(mat), 
                      Vectorize(function(i,j) {
                        both_sig <- sum(mat[,i] & mat[,j], na.rm=TRUE)
                        either_sig <- sum(mat[,i] | mat[,j], na.rm=TRUE)
                        both_sig/either_sig  # similarity
                      }))

    rownames(matrices[["jaccard"]]) <- colnames(matrices[["jaccard"]]) <- colnames(mat)

    # Check overlap between pairwise-tested >> intersection set
    matrices[["jaccard_intersection"]] <- outer(1:ncol(mat), 1:ncol(mat), 
                      Vectorize(function(i,j) {
                        tmp <- mat[(!is.na(mat[,i]) & !is.na(mat[,j])),]
                        both_sig <- sum(tmp[,i] & tmp[,j], na.rm=TRUE)
                        either_sig <- sum(tmp[,i] | tmp[,j], na.rm=TRUE)
                        both_sig/either_sig  # similarity
                      }))

    rownames(matrices[["jaccard_intersection"]]) <- colnames(matrices[["jaccard_intersection"]]) <- colnames(mat)

    all_mats[[d]][[c]] <- matrices # All correlation and jaccard matrices

    ##########################################################
    # Calculate summary statistics and add to stats_dataset  #
    ##########################################################

    for (var in c("cormat_est", "cormat_stat", "jaccard")) {
      # union
      mat <- matrices[[var]]
      diag(mat) <- NA

      # Intersection
      mat_pairs <- matrices[[paste0(var, "_intersection")]]
      diag(mat_pairs) <- NA

      # Remove pipeline=="Expected" from matrix (should not weigh into the between-pipeline average)
      if ("Expected" %in% colnames(mat)) {
        mat <- data.frame(mat) %>% 
          select(-Expected) %>%
          rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline") %>%
          filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>%
          column_to_rownames(var = "pipeline")

        # Intersection
        mat_pairs <- data.frame(mat_pairs) %>% 
          select(-Expected) %>%
          rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline") %>%
          filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>%
          column_to_rownames(var = "pipeline")
      }

      df_toadd <- data.frame(pipeline = colnames(mat),
                            avg = rowMeans(mat, na.rm=TRUE),
                            avg_pairs=rowMeans(mat_pairs, na.rm=TRUE))
      
      base <- case_when(grepl("est", var) ~ "corest",
                        grepl("stat", var) ~ "corstat",
                        grepl("jaccard", var) ~ "jaccard")

      colnames(df_toadd) <- c("pipeline",
                              paste0("da_", base, "_ave_", c),
                              paste0("da_", base, "_intersection_ave_", c))
      
      stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
        dplyr::left_join(., df_toadd, by = "pipeline")

    }

    # For simulated datasets, also add the correlation with the expected associations 
    if (d %in% sims & !c %in% "def") {
      for (var in c("cormat_est", "cormat_stat", "jaccard")) {
        mat <- matrices[[var]] %>% data.frame() %>% 
          select(Expected) %>% 
          rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline") %>% 
          filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected")

        mat_pairs <- matrices[[paste0(var, "_intersection")]] %>% data.frame() %>% 
          select(Expected) %>% 
          rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline") %>% 
          filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected")

        df_toadd <- mat %>% 
          dplyr::left_join(., mat_pairs, by = "pipeline")
        
        base <- case_when(grepl("est", var) ~ "corest",
                          grepl("stat", var) ~ "corstat",
                          grepl("jaccard", var) ~ "jaccard")

        colnames(df_toadd) <- c("pipeline",
                                paste0("da_", base, "_exp_", c),
                                paste0("da_", base, "_intersection_exp_", c))
        
        stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
          dplyr::left_join(., df_toadd, by = "pipeline")
      }
    }

    ##############################################################
    # Extract the proportion of pipelines with sig associations  #
    ##############################################################
    
    npipeline <- sum(!unique(df$pipeline) %in% "Expected")

    # How often is each genus called significant (count, proportion by tested, proportion by total pipelines)
    sigcount <- df_union %>% 
      filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>% 
      group_by(genus) %>% 
      summarize(n_tested = n(), n_tot=npipeline, n_sig = sum(padj < p_thres)) %>%
      mutate(prop_sig_tested = n_sig/n_tested,
            prop_sig = n_sig/n_tot)

    df <- df %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(., sigcount, by = "genus") %>% 
      mutate(propsig_cat = case_when(
            prop_sig >= 1 ~ "100%",
            prop_sig >= 0.75 ~ "75-99%",
            prop_sig >= 0.50 ~ "50-74%",
            prop_sig >= 0.25 ~ "25-49%",
            TRUE ~ "0-24%")) %>%
      mutate(propsig_cat = factor(propsig_cat, levels = c("100%", "75-99%", "50-74%", "25-49%", "0-24%"))) %>%
      mutate(genus_old = genus) %>%
      mutate(genus = gsub("X\\.", "[", genus_old)) %>%
      mutate(genus = gsub("\\._", "]_", genus)) %>%
      mutate(genus = gsub("\\.", "-", genus))

    abs <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "abundance_distributions.rds"))[[d]][[c]] %>%
          rownames_to_column(var = "genus") %>%
          mutate(genus = gsub("\\.\\.+\\d+", "", genus)) 
          
    df <- df %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(., abs, by = c("pipeline", "genus"))          

    all_df[[d]][[c]] <- df # all summarystats + derivatives (how often tested, how often significant, average abundance etc. )

    # Create a proportion table (0-24, 25-49, 50-74, 75-99, 100) and add frequencies to stats_dataset
    df_toadd <- df %>% 
      filter(padj < p_thres) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines)) %>% 
      group_by(pipeline, propsig_cat) %>%
      summarize(n = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
      complete(pipeline, propsig_cat, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
      filter(!pipeline %in% c("Expected", "eDNAFlow")) %>% 
      group_by(pipeline) %>% 
      mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
      select(-n) %>%
      pivot_wider(id_cols = pipeline, names_from = propsig_cat, values_from = prop)
    
    colnames(df_toadd) <- c("pipeline", paste0(c("da_sig100", "da_sig5074", "da_sig7599", "da_sig2549", "da_sig024"), "_", c))

    stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(., df_toadd, by = "pipeline")

  }
}

saveRDS(all_mats, file = paste0(output_path, "da_corstats.rds"))
saveRDS(all_df, file = paste0(output_path, "da_probsig.rds"))
saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da.rds"))

jaccard_correlation_genusstat <- all_mats 
get_list_names(jaccard_correlation_genusstat) %>% print()

save(jaccard_correlation_genusstat, file = paste0(output_path, "jaccard_correlation_genusstat.RData"))
```

# Recall and precision for DA 
```{r da_recall_precision, eval=TRUE,include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da.rds"))
da_stats <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "differential_abundance_stats.rds"))
df <- da_stats$df 

# List of expected genera
exp_gen <- df %>% 
  filter(dataset %in% "miseq_v4_sim") %>% 
  filter(pipeline %in% "Expected") %>% 
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  pull(genus) %>% unique()

# P-value threshold
p_thres <- 0.05

# df to add TP, FP, FN associated genera
fpfn <- data.frame(dataset = character(),
                  classifier = character(),
                  pipeline = character(),
                  genus = character(),
                  status = character())

# Calculate precision/recall
precision_recall <- lapply(sims, function(d) {
  lapply(classifiers, function(c) {

    df_tmp <- df %>% 
      filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>% 
      filter(dataset == d, classifier == c) %>%
      filter(padj < p_thres) %>% 
      mutate(true_da = ifelse(genus %in% exp_gen, TRUE, FALSE),
            detected_da = padj < p_thres)
    
    precision_recall <- lapply(unique(df_tmp$pipeline), function(pip) {
      df_sub <- df_tmp %>%
        filter(pipeline == pip)
  
      TP <- sum(df_sub$true_da == TRUE & df_sub$detected_da == TRUE, na.rm=TRUE)
      FP <- sum(df_sub$true_da == FALSE & df_sub$detected_da == TRUE, na.rm=TRUE)
      FN <- sum(!exp_gen %in% df_sub$genus) 
      
      precision <- ifelse((TP + FP) > 0, TP / (TP + FP), NA)
      recall <- ifelse((TP + FN) > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA)

      FP_gen <- df_sub$genus[df_sub$true_da == FALSE & df_sub$detected_da == TRUE]
      FN_gen <- exp_gen[!exp_gen %in% df_sub$genus]
      TP_gen <- df_sub$genus[df_sub$true_da == TRUE & df_sub$detected_da == TRUE]

      fpfn <<- fpfn %>%
        bind_rows(tibble(dataset = d, classifier = c, pipeline = pip, genus = FP_gen, status = "FP")) %>%
        bind_rows(tibble(dataset = d, classifier = c, pipeline = pip, genus = FN_gen, status = "FN")) %>%
        bind_rows(tibble(dataset = d, classifier = c, pipeline = pip, genus = TP_gen, status = "TP"))

      data.frame(pipeline = pip,
                precision = precision,
                recall = recall,
                dataset = d,
                classifier = c)

    }) %>% bind_rows()
  }) %>% bind_rows()
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Add precision and recall to stats_dataset for plotting later 
for (d in sims) {
  tmp <- precision_recall %>%
    filter(dataset %in% d) %>%
    select(-dataset) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = classifier,
      values_from = c(precision, recall),
      names_glue = "da_{.value}_{classifier}"
    )

  stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
    dplyr::left_join(., tmp, by = "pipeline")
}

saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2.rds"))

``` 

# Overall performance
## Z-score benchmark metrics
Here we z-score all relevant benchmark metrics into 4 main categories:
1. fr_ : feature recovery
2. aa_ : abundance accuracy
3. sr_ : stats recovery
4. sa_ : stats accuracy
 
Moverover, we create an overall performance score capturing performance across datasets and feature levels 

```{r zscores, eval=FALSE,include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2.rds"))
inv <- c("fr_jaccard", "sa_alpha", "sa_beta") # Variables to inverse (higher > worse to higher > better)

stats_comb <- list() # list to store all z-scored metrics

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  # Metric specific to real datasets
  if (d %in% reals) {
    tmp <-  stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
      select(pipeline,
            fr_jaccard_asv = distave_jaccard_asv249, # jaccard dissimilarity (higher is worse)
            fr_jaccard_q2 = distave_jaccard_q2,
            fr_jaccard_idtaxa = distave_jaccard_idtaxa,
            aa_cor_clr_asv = cor_clr_asv249,  # correlation clr
            aa_cor_clr_q2 = cor_clr_q2, 
            aa_cor_clr_idtaxa = cor_clr_idtaxa,
            sa_alpha_shannon_ave = alpha_shannon_ave,# alpha effect sizes
            sa_alpha_observed_ave = alpha_observed_ave,# alpha effect sizes
            sa_beta_aitchison_ave = beta_aitchison_ave,
            sa_beta_jaccard_ave = beta_jaccard_ave,
            sa_cor_ave_q2 = da_corest_ave_q2,
            sa_cor_ave_idtaxa = da_corest_ave_idtaxa, 
            sr_jaccard_q2 = da_jaccard_ave_q2, # da jaccard similarity (higher = better)
            sr_jaccard_idtaxa = da_jaccard_ave_idtaxa) 
  } else {
    tmp <- data.frame(pipeline = stats_dataset[[d]]$pipeline)
  }

  # Metric specific to ground-truth datasets (mock & sim)
  if (d %in% c(mocks, sims)) {
    tmp1 <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
        select(pipeline,
          # recall (1)
          fr_recall_asv = recallrate,
          fr_recall_q2 = recallrate_genus_q2,
          fr_recall_idtaxa = recallrate_genus_idtaxa,
          # Precision (1)
          fr_precision_asv = precisionrate,
          fr_precision_q2 = precisionrate_genus_q2,
          fr_precision_idtaxa = precisionrate_genus_idtaxa,
          # cor to exp
          aa_cor_clr_exp_asv = cor_clr_exp_asv, 
          aa_cor_clr_exp_q2 = cor_clr_exp_q2,
          aa_cor_clr_exp_idtaxa = cor_clr_exp_idtaxa
        )

      tmp1 <- tmp1 %>%  
        mutate(fr_f1_asv = 2 * (fr_precision_asv * fr_recall_asv) / (fr_precision_asv + fr_recall_asv),
               fr_f1_q2 = 2 * (fr_precision_q2 * fr_recall_q2) / (fr_precision_q2 + fr_recall_q2),
               fr_f1_idtaxa = 2 * (fr_precision_idtaxa * fr_recall_idtaxa) / (fr_precision_idtaxa + fr_recall_idtaxa))
  } else {
    tmp1 <- data.frame(pipeline = stats_dataset[[d]]$pipeline)
  }

  # Metric specific to simulated datasets
  if (d %in% c(sims)) {
    tmp2 <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
        select(pipeline,
          sa_alpha_shannon_exp = alpha_shannon_exp,
          sa_alpha_observed_exp = alpha_observed_exp,
          sa_beta_aitchison_exp = beta_aitchison_exp,
          sa_beta_jaccard_exp = beta_jaccard_exp,
          sa_cor_exp_q2 = da_corest_exp_q2,
          sa_cor_exp_idtaxa = da_corest_exp_idtaxa,
          # recall (1)
          sr_recall_q2 = da_recall_q2,
          sr_recall_idtaxa = da_recall_idtaxa,
          # Precision (1)
          sr_precision_q2 = da_precision_q2,
          sr_precision_idtaxa = da_precision_idtaxa,
        )

    tmp2 <- tmp2 %>%  
        mutate(sr_f1_q2 = 2 * (sr_precision_q2 * sr_recall_q2) / (sr_precision_q2 + sr_recall_q2),
               sr_f1_idtaxa = 2 * (sr_precision_idtaxa * sr_recall_idtaxa) / (sr_precision_idtaxa + sr_recall_idtaxa))
  } else {
    tmp2 <- data.frame(pipeline = stats_dataset[[d]]$pipeline)
  }

  tmp <- tmp %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(., tmp1, by = "pipeline") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(., tmp2, by = "pipeline") %>%
    filter(!pipeline %in% c("LotuS2_otu"))
  
  tmp_scaled <- tmp %>% 
    mutate(across(starts_with(c("sa_alpha", "sa_beta")), ~ abs(.x))) %>% # pos and neg deviations should be treated the same here
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)), .names = "{.col}")) %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with(inv), ~ -.x)) # flip sign so higher = better; note: jaccard is still dissimilarity (not similarity), so lower = better
  
  tmp_ranked <- tmp_scaled %>%
    mutate(across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ { r <- rank(.x, ties.method = "min", na.last = "keep")
          ifelse(is.na(.x), NA_real_, r) },
      .names = "{.col}"
    ))

  # Z-scoring across (instead of within) feature level to assess differences between ASV and genus 
  tmp_feat <- tmp %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = -pipeline, names_to="variable", values_to="value") %>%
    mutate(vtype = sapply(str_split(variable, "_"), head, 1)) %>% 
    filter(!vtype %in% c("sr", "sa")) %>% 
    mutate(classifier = sapply(str_split(variable, "_"), tail, 1)) %>%
    mutate(featlevel = ifelse(classifier %in% "asv", "ASV", "Genus"))

  feat_scaled <- tmp_feat %>% 
    mutate(variable = variable %>% 
           str_remove(paste0("_", classifier))) %>%
    select(-c(vtype, classifier)) %>%
    group_by(pipeline, variable, featlevel) %>% 
    summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(pipeline, featlevel), names_from="variable", values_from="value") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)), .names = "{.col}")) %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with(inv), ~ -.x)) # flip sign so higher = better

  # Z-scoring across (instead of within) classifier to assess differences between classifiers 
  class_scaled <- tmp_feat %>% 
    filter(!featlevel %in% "ASV") %>% 
    mutate(variable = variable %>% 
           str_remove(paste0("_", classifier))) %>%
    select(-c(vtype, featlevel)) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(pipeline, classifier), names_from="variable", values_from="value") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)), .names = "{.col}")) %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with(inv), ~ -.x)) # flip sign so higher = better

  stats_comb[["raw"]][[d]] <- tmp
  stats_comb[["zscore"]][[d]] <- tmp_scaled
  stats_comb[["ranked"]][[d]] <- tmp_ranked
  stats_comb[["feat_zscore"]][[d]] <- feat_scaled
  stats_comb[["classifier_zscore"]][[d]] <- class_scaled


} 

# Compile all transformed metrics into one dataframe
df_all <- lapply(datasets$dataset, function(d) {  # Combine metrics from different datasets
  df <- stats_comb[["zscore"]][[d]] %>%
    pivot_longer(-pipeline, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>% 
    mutate(group = sapply(str_split(variable, "_"), head, 1)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  # complete(pipeline, variable, dataset, fill = list(value = NA)) %>%
  # Categorize data types (mock, sim, real)
  mutate(dtype = case_when(dataset %in% mocks ~ "Mock",
                           dataset %in% sims ~ "Simulation",
                           dataset %in% reals ~ "Real")) %>%
  mutate(dtype = factor(dtype, levels = c("Mock", "Simulation", "Real")),
         vtype = sapply(str_split(variable, "_"), head, 1), # variable type (fr, aa, sr, sa)
         ctype = case_when(grepl("q2", variable) ~ "q2", # feature levels * classifiers (q2, idtaxa, asv or statistics) 
                           grepl("idtaxa", variable) ~ "idtaxa",
                           grepl("asv", variable) ~ "asv",
                           TRUE ~ "stats")) %>%
  mutate(classifier = case_when(grepl("_q2", variable) ~ "q2", # classifiers (q2, idtaxa)
                                grepl("_idtaxa", variable) ~ "idtaxa")) %>%
  mutate(featlevel = case_when(ctype %in% c("q2", "idtaxa") ~ "Genus", # feature-level (Genus, ASV, stats)
                               ctype %in% "asv" ~ "ASV",
                               ctype %in% "stats" ~ "Statistics")) 

stats_comb[["all"]] <- df_all # add to big list for later access 

# Calculate the overall score
d_performance <- df_all %>% 
  filter(!grepl("recall|precision", variable)) %>% # remove recall/precision because they are combined into F1 score to avoid cancelling out 
  mutate(metric_base = variable %>% 
           str_remove("_q2$") %>% 
           str_remove("_idtaxa$")) %>% 
  # Average across idtaxa and q2 classifiers (treat as one variable for overall scoring)
  group_by(pipeline, dataset, metric_base) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Average across avs and genus level 
  mutate(metric_base = metric_base %>% 
           str_remove("_asv$")) %>% 
  group_by(pipeline, dataset, metric_base) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric_base = metric_base %>%
           str_remove("_exp$") %>%
           str_remove("_ave$")) %>%
  # Average across alpha metrics (shannon, observed) and across beta metrics (aitchison, jaccard)
  mutate(metric_base = metric_base %>%
           str_remove("_exp$") %>%
           str_remove("_ave$")) %>%
  mutate(metric_base = metric_base %>%
           str_replace("_alpha_shannon", "_alpha") %>%
           str_replace("_alpha_observed", "_alpha") %>%
           str_replace("_beta_jaccard", "_beta") %>%
           str_replace("_beta_aitchison", "_beta")) %>% 
  group_by(pipeline, dataset, metric_base) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Average across metric groups (feature recovery (fr), abundance accuracy (aa), stats recovery (sr), stats accuracy (aa)
  mutate(vtype = sapply(str_split(metric_base, "_"), head, 1)) %>% 
  group_by(pipeline, dataset, vtype) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Average by dataset
  group_by(pipeline, dataset) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")  

# Calculate overall performance 
overall_performance <- d_performance %>% 
  filter(!pipeline %in% c("LotuS2_otu", "eDNAFlow")) %>% 
  group_by(pipeline) %>% 
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(value) 
colnames(overall_performance)[2] <- "performance"

# Add to stats_dataset 
for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  df_toadd <- d_performance %>% 
    filter(dataset %in% d) %>%
    select(-dataset, performance_dataset=value) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(., overall_performance , by = "pipeline")

  stats_dataset[[d]] <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(., df_toadd, by = "pipeline")
}

# Save
saveRDS(stats_comb, file = paste0(output_path, "combined_performance.rds"))
saveRDS(stats_dataset, file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))

```

## Ground-truth vs. Consensus associations
```{r groundtruth, eval=FALSE,include=TRUE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))

df <- lapply(sims, function(d) {
  stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(pipeline,
                           # jaccard 
                           dist_ave_asv = distave_jaccard_asv249,
                           dist_ave_q2 = distave_jaccard_q2,
                           dist_exp_asv = distexp_jaccard_asv_exp,
                           dist_exp_q2 = distexp_jaccard_q2,
                           # Correlation
                           cor_ave_asv = cor_clr_asv249,
                           cor_ave_q2 = cor_clr_q2,
                           cor_exp_asv = cor_clr_exp_asv,
                           cor_exp_q2 = cor_clr_exp_q2,
                           # Shannon
                           observed_ave = alpha_observed_ave,
                           observed_exp = alpha_observed_exp,
                           # aitchison
                           aitchison_ave = beta_aitchison_ave,
                           aitchison_exp = beta_aitchison_exp,
                           # DA Jaccard 
                           dajaccard_ave = da_jaccard_ave_q2,
                           dajaccard_exp = da_jaccard_exp_q2,
                           # DA Correlation
                           dacor_ave = da_corest_ave_q2,
                           dacor_exp = da_corest_exp_q2) %>%
                          mutate(dataset=d) 
}) %>% bind_rows %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=-c(pipeline, dataset), names_to="variable", values_to="values") %>%
  mutate(featlevel = case_when(grepl("_asv", variable) ~ "ASV",
                   grepl("_q2", variable) ~ "Genus",
                   TRUE ~ "Statistics")) %>%
  mutate(reference = ifelse(grepl("exp", variable), "expected", "consensus")) %>% 
  mutate(metric_base = variable %>% 
                        str_remove("_asv") %>% 
                        str_remove("_q2") %>%
                        str_remove("_ave") %>% 
                        str_remove("_exp")) %>%
  filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu")

cor_df <- data.frame(var = character(), ndat = numeric(), nobs = numeric(), featlevel = character(), cor_pearson = numeric(), CI = character())
pltlist <- list()
titles <- c("dist" = "Jaccard", "cor" = "Correlation", "observed" = "Observed Richness", "aitchison" = "Aitchison Dissimilarity", "dajaccard" = "DA Jaccard", "dacor" = "DA Correlation")

for (m in unique(df$metric_base)) {
  for (lev in unique(df$featlevel)) {
    
    nvar <- df %>% filter(metric_base %in% m, featlevel %in% lev) %>% nrow()
    if (nvar == 0) next

    sub <- df %>% filter(metric_base %in% m, featlevel %in% lev) %>% 
      select(pipeline, dataset, values, reference) %>% 
      pivot_wider(id_cols=c(pipeline, dataset), values_from="values", names_from="reference") %>%
      filter(!is.na(consensus) | !is.na(expected))

    cor_pears <- cor(sub$consensus, sub$expected, method="pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    cor_pears_CI <- cor.test(sub$consensus, sub$expected, method="pearson", use="pairwise.complete.obs", conf.level = 0.95)

    pltlist[[paste(m, lev, sep="_")]] <- sub %>% ggplot(aes(x=consensus, y=expected)) + 
      geom_point() + 
      geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE, color="blue") +
      my_theme(theme_bw) +
      labs(title = paste(lev, titles[[m]]), subtitle = paste("r = ", round(cor_pears, 3))) +
      xlab("Consensus") + ylab("Expected")

    cor_df <- cor_df %>% 
      add_row(var = m, 
              ndat = unique(sub$dataset) %>% length(),
              nobs = sum(!is.na(sub$consensus) & !is.na(sub$expected)),
              featlevel=lev,
              cor_pearson = cor_pears,
              CI = paste0(round(cor_pears_CI$conf.int[1], 3), "-", round(cor_pears_CI$conf.int[2], 3))) 
  }
}

comb <- ggarrange(plotlist = pltlist, ncol=4, nrow=2)
ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "SFigure_consensus.pdf"), plot = comb, device = cairo_pdf, width = 10, height = 5)
```

# Effect of filtering
## Effect of filtering on ground-truth metrics 
How does filtering affect recall and precision 
```{r FN_abundance, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

seq_length <- read_tsv("/projects/0/gs/danique/pipelines/int_results/seq_length.tsv") # for sequence length filter
ab_stats <- list()

# Collect information about each feature (seq length, sum of relative abundance, sum of counts, prevalence etc.)
for (d in c(sims)) {  
  # Abundance of FP vs TP (- observed)
  tse_asv <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_tp", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))
  tse_asv_idtaxa <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_idtaxa_tp", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))

  lev <- "asv"
  ave_ab <- data.frame(pipeline = character(),
                      id = character(),
                      tp = character(),
                      seq_length = numeric(),
                      sum = numeric(),
                      sum_count = numeric(),
                      max_relab = numeric(),
                      max_count = numeric(),
                      count_u5 = numeric(), # <= 5 is TRUE, >5 is FALSE 
                      prev_n = numeric(), # number of samples with count > 0
                      prev_1 = numeric(), # present in 1=TRUE, present in >1 sample=FALSE
                      ave = numeric(),
                      prev = numeric())

    tmp <- get(paste0("tse_", lev))
    
    # Loop through pipelines
    for (p in pipelines) {

      if (p %in% "Expected") next
      print(paste("Dataset:", d, "Pipeline:", p, "Level:", lev))
      seq_sub <- seq_length %>% filter(Dataset %in% d, Pipeline %in% p)

      tmp_sub <- tmp[[p]]
      if (is.null(tmp_sub)) next

      tax <- rowData(tmp_sub) %>% data.frame() %>% 
        rownames_to_column("ID") %>%
        dplyr::left_join(., seq_sub, by = "ID") %>%
        column_to_rownames("ID")
      
      rowData(tmp_sub) <- DataFrame(tax)      
      
      if (ncol(tmp_sub) == 0) next
      tmp_sub <- transformAssay(tmp_sub, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = FALSE)

      new_row <- data.frame(pipeline = p,
                            id = rownames(tmp_sub), 
                            tp = rowData(tmp_sub)$tp,
                            seq_length = rowData(tmp_sub)$Length,
                            sum = rowSums(assay(tmp_sub, "relabundance")),
                            sum_count = rowSums(assay(tmp_sub, "counts")),
                            max_relab = apply(assay(tmp_sub, "relabundance"), 1, max),
                            max_count = apply(assay(tmp_sub, "counts"), 1, max),
                            count_u5 = rowSums(assay(tmp_sub, "counts")) <= 5,
                            ave = rowMeans(assay(tmp_sub, "relabundance")),
                            prev = rowSums(assay(tmp_sub) > 0) / ncol(tmp_sub) * 100,
                            prev_n = rowSums(assay(tmp_sub) > 0),
                            prev_1 = rowSums(assay(tmp_sub) > 0) == 1)
     
      ave_ab <- ave_ab %>%
        add_row(new_row)       
    }

    ave_ab <- ave_ab %>% mutate(tp = ifelse(tp %in% "TP", "TP", "FP"))
    ab_stats[[d]][[lev]] <- ave_ab
}

# Save the list with all sequence information 
saveRDS(ab_stats, file = paste0(output_path, "ab_stats.rds"))

##################### 
# Perform filtering #
#####################

# ab_stats <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "ab_stats.rds")) 
alloutput <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "all_tables_combined.rds")) # for recall/precision tables

# initialize data frame to store post-filter metrics
prev_df <- data.frame(dataset = character(),
                     pipeline = character(),
                     filttype = character(),
                     threshold = numeric(),
                     n_tp = numeric(),
                     n_fp = numeric(),
                     n_fn = numeric(),
                     precicion = numeric(),
                     precicion_perc = numeric(),
                     recall = numeric())

calc_recall <- function(id, recall) {
  # Convert id to character set for fast lookup
  id_set <- as.character(id)
  
  # Pre-split once with fixed = TRUE
  split_matches <- strsplit(recall$ASV_0_mismatch, ";", fixed = TRUE)
  
  # Count matches directly (no need to store vector)
  nfn <- sum(vapply(split_matches, function(matches) {
    any(matches %in% id_set)
  }, logical(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE))
  
  newrecall <- nfn / length(split_matches)
  
  return(list(recall = newrecall, nfn = nfn))
}

for (d in sims) {
  for (p in unique(ab_stats[[d]][["asv"]]$pipeline)) {

    print(paste("Dataset:", d, "| Pipeline:", p))

    # load recall tables
    recall <- alloutput[[d]][[p]][["recall"]] %>%
      rownames_to_column("id") 
    data_df <- ab_stats[[d]][["asv"]] %>% filter(pipeline %in% p) 

    print("Prevalence filter")
    for (i in 1:6) { # present in >-1-6 samples (1=no filtering, 6= present in 6 or more samples)
      data_df_filt <- data_df %>% filter(prev_n >= i)
      n_tp <- sum(data_df_filt$tp %in% "TP")
      n_fp <- sum(data_df_filt$tp %in% "FP")
      prec <- n_tp / nrow(data_df_filt)
      prec_perc <- sum(data_df_filt$sum[data_df_filt$tp %in% "TP"]) / sum(data_df_filt$sum)

      rec <- calc_recall(data_df_filt$id, recall)

      prev_df <- prev_df %>%
        add_row(dataset=d,
                pipeline=p,
                filttype="prev",
                threshold=i,
                n_tp = n_tp,
                n_fp = n_fp,
                n_fn = rec$nfn,
                precicion = prec,
                precicion_perc = prec_perc,
                recall = rec$recall)
    }

    # Count filter
    print("Count filter")
    for (i in 1:10) { # total count between 1-10 (1==1 or more/no filter, 10 is 10 or more )
      data_df_filt <- data_df %>% filter(sum_count >= i)
      n_tp <- sum(data_df_filt$tp %in% "TP")
      n_fp <- sum(data_df_filt$tp %in% "FP")
      prec <- n_tp / nrow(data_df_filt)
      prec_perc <- sum(data_df_filt$sum[data_df_filt$tp %in% "TP"]) / sum(data_df_filt$sum)

      rec <- calc_recall(data_df_filt$id, recall)

      prev_df <- prev_df %>%
      add_row(dataset=d,
              pipeline=p,
              filttype="count",
              threshold=i,
              n_tp = n_tp,
              n_fp = n_fp,
              n_fn = rec$nfn,
              precicion = prec,
              precicion_perc = prec_perc,
              recall = rec$recall)
    }

    print("Filter short sequences ")
    for (i in 0:1) { # no filter (0) vs filter sequnces < 240

      if (i == 1 && !p %in% c("NGTax2", "AMPtk", "LotuS2", "LotuS2_otu", "QIIME2_Deblur")) {
        data_df_filt <- data_df %>% filter(seq_length > 240)
      } else {
        data_df_filt <- data_df
      }
      
      n_tp <- sum(data_df_filt$tp %in% "TP")
      n_fp <- sum(data_df_filt$tp %in% "FP")
      prec <- n_tp / nrow(data_df_filt)
      prec_perc <- sum(data_df_filt$sum[data_df_filt$tp %in% "TP"]) / sum(data_df_filt$sum)

      rec <- calc_recall(data_df_filt$id, recall)

      prev_df <- prev_df %>%
      add_row(dataset=d,
              pipeline=p,
              filttype="short_seq",
              threshold=i,
              n_tp = n_tp,
              n_fp = n_fp,
              n_fn = rec$nfn,
              precicion = prec,
              precicion_perc = prec_perc,
              recall = rec$recall)
    }

    print("Filter long sequences ")
    for (i in 0:1) { # no filter (0) vs filter sequnces >260

      if (i == 1 && !p %in% c("NGTax2", "AMPtk", "LotuS2", "LotuS2_otu", "QIIME2_Deblur")) {
        data_df_filt <- data_df %>% filter(seq_length < 260)
      } else {
        data_df_filt <- data_df
      }
      
      n_tp <- sum(data_df_filt$tp %in% "TP")
      n_fp <- sum(data_df_filt$tp %in% "FP")
      prec <- n_tp / nrow(data_df_filt)
      prec_perc <- sum(data_df_filt$sum[data_df_filt$tp %in% "TP"]) / sum(data_df_filt$sum)

      rec <- calc_recall(data_df_filt$id, recall)

      prev_df <- prev_df %>%
      add_row(dataset=d,
              pipeline=p,
              filttype="long_seq",
              threshold=i,
              n_tp = n_tp,
              n_fp = n_fp,
              n_fn = rec$nfn,
              precicion = prec,
              precicion_perc = prec_perc,
              recall = rec$recall)
    }
  }
}
```
